episodes.historian_review: Confirmed: the only score event was +5 for "take egg" in Up a Tree. Taking a visible portable object and checking the score was the strongest decision. Navigation transitions were all confirmed, so movement mechanics were not the problem. The Actor itself stalled. The visible trajectory is repetitive: Forest Path, Clearing, Forest and Up a Tree were cycled with no score change. Repeated take/drop leaves and up/down tree pairs produced nothing. The "explore frontier" goals kept routing into rooms already visited. The Actor never reached an underground area. It noted a grating in Clearing (#143) but never examined or tested it, which was a missed opportunity. Whether the egg stayed in inventory is unclear, because the notes say empty-handed. Next episode: cap zero-progress loops at roughly 20-30 steps, check inventory, examine fixed features with several verbs, and pick exits not yet used, such as around the house.

positives: Take portable objects in newly entered rooms and compare score immediately; taking the egg in Up a Tree gave a recorded +5.
Use room ids to tell apart same-named rooms, such as Clearing #74 versus #143, before declaring a location new.
When a fixed feature like a grating is noticed, examine it and try several plausible verbs on it before leaving.
Run 'inventory' after any score event to confirm what is carried, and avoid dropping items that may have scored.
Before leaving a new room, run look and examine each listed object once, then record what changed.
Choose exits whose destinations are absent from the visited list; verify against the list before labeling a move as frontier exploration.
Rely on confirmed transitions to build a map of exits, then use it to select unexplored branches methodically.
After about 20 steps with no score or new room, switch to a different region or a different verb type.
negatives: Do not repeat take/drop leaves; many repeats across several rooms gave zero score and no new information.
Do not oscillate between Forest Path, Clearing and Forest; this loop consumed hundreds of steps without discovering anything.
Do not repeat up/down tree pairs once the room is examined; they produced no score after the first visit.
Do not call a move 'frontier exploration' when the destination was already visited; this mislabeling hid the lack of progress.
Do not ignore noted fixed features such as the grating; leaving them untested wasted a concrete lead.
Do not stay in the same ten-room area for 500 steps; unvisited exits near the house were left untried.
Do not assume inventory state from memory; the notes repeatedly said 'empty-handed' without verification after taking the egg.
Do not spend actions on 'go around forest' loops; the same movement cycle recurred with identical results.

Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

episodes.historian_review: Final score was 32 (peak 42) before death at step 365. Recorded score events: take egg +5, entering Kitchen through the window +10, put egg in case +2, and down to the Cellar +25. Taking the sword in the Troll room cost −10 and ended the episode. Strong Actor choices: opening the window, opening the case before depositing the egg, moving the rug and opening the trap door, and lighting the lantern. Ineffective: roughly steps 1–290 cycled through Clearing, Forest, Forest Path, Up a Tree and Behind House, with repeated open/close on the egg, nest and window and no score. Later, Cellar/East Chasm/Troll shuttling produced nothing, and the Actor returned to the troll after one missed hit. Untried: Gallery objects, Kitchen chimney, Attic, Cellar west ramp. Advice: after 20 scoreless steps, change region or verb type, and avoid the troll room. Navigation transitions were confirmed; the failures were Actor decisions.

positives: Open the window Behind House and enter the Kitchen; the recorded +10 came on that entry. Reach it quickly.
Open the trophy case before depositing treasure; put egg in case gave a recorded +2, so repeat that sequence.
Push the rug and open the trap door to reach the Cellar; that descent recorded +25.
Take portable objects in new rooms and compare score at once; take egg in Up a Tree recorded +5.
Light the lantern before the dark Attic or underground rooms; the Attic was dark and risky.
Check room ids to tell same-named rooms apart (Clearing #74 vs #143) before calling a destination new.
After 20 steps with no score or new room, switch to a different region or verb type.
Before leaving Gallery, East Chasm, Attic or Kitchen, examine each listed object and untested exit once, and record the result.
negatives: Do not cycle Clearing, Forest, Forest Path and Up a Tree; about 290 steps there gave no score.
Do not repeat open/close on the egg, nest or window; these toggles produced no score and no new route.
Do not shuttle Cellar, East Chasm and Troll without a new action; roughly 20 steps passed with no score.
Do not take items or fight in the Troll room; taking the sword there cost −10 and killed the Actor.
Do not return to the troll after a missed hit; the first swing was dodged and the counterattack was lethal.
Do not call 'go around forest' or up/down tree moves frontier exploration; they only revisited known rooms.
Do not leave Gallery, the Kitchen chimney, the Attic and the Cellar's west ramp unexamined while looping elsewhere.
Do not pick up the sword or other items next to a hostile creature without checking its state.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.

episodes.historian_review: Confirmed score: +10 for west into the Kitchen and +25 for down to the Cellar. The death penalty took the final score from 35 to 25. Strongest decisions: opening the window before entering the Kitchen, and pushing the rug and opening the trap door before descending. That route (Behind House, Kitchen, Living Room, trap door) is now verified. Ineffective: steps 2-7 shuttled West House and North House with no gain. Steps 17-20 shuttled Kitchen and Living Room. Fifteen steps passed before the first score. Missed: the egg (+5, then +2 in the case) was never taken. In the pitch-black Cellar, the Actor wasted a turn dropping the leaflet, then moved south and was eaten by a grue (-10). The troll-room sword death is from earlier episodes; the Troll room stays high risk. Untried: Gallery, East Chasm, Cellar crawlway. Next time, secure light before descending.

positives: Use the verified route: Behind House, open window, west to Kitchen (+10), Living Room, push rug, open trap door, down (+25).
Reach the Kitchen directly; this episode scored first at step 16 after six wasted moves between West House and North House.
Take the egg in Up a Tree (+5) and put it in the open trophy case (+2); check the score after each.
Secure a light source before descending; the Cellar was pitch black and the trap door crashed shut behind the Actor.
In a dark room, do not guess exits; light it, or take the one known safe action, before any frontier move.
After descending, explore the untried exits (Gallery, East Chasm, Cellar crawlway) one at a time once light is available.
Check room ids to tell same-named rooms apart (Clearing #74 vs #143) before calling a destination new.
After 20 steps with no score or new room, switch region or verb type instead of repeating moves.
negatives: Do not move into unexplored exits in a pitch-black room; going south from the dark Cellar caused grue death and a −10 penalty.
Do not shuttle West House and North House; three round trips yielded nothing new and cost six steps.
Do not shuttle Kitchen and Living Room without a new action; four such moves passed with zero score.
Do not take the sword or any item in the Troll room with the troll awake; that killed the Actor earlier. Treat it as high risk.
Do not waste turns in dark rooms on inventory actions like dropping the leaflet; they gain nothing while a grue threat exists.
Do not cycle Clearing, Forest and Forest Path or use 'go around forest'; it only revisits known rooms.
Do not repeat open/close toggles on the egg, nest, window or mailbox; they gave no score or new route.
Do not descend the trap door unprepared; it shut behind the Actor, and no return route home was verified.

recent_steps.actor_state_note: Moving north to explore the Troll room for potential interactions.

episodes.historian_review: Score rose from 0 to 30 over 290 steps: egg +5 (Up a Tree), Kitchen +10, Cellar +25, then a terminal −10. The trophy-case +2 is not in the evidence, so I do not credit it. The strongest decision came late: opening the window, entering the Kitchen, taking the lantern, lighting it, moving the rug and opening the trap door before descending. The Cellar +25 came on that descent. The final −10 followed 'north' from the lit Cellar into the Troll Room, where a troll was described. The truncated observation does not show the death text, so the cause is unconfirmed. Nothing in the evidence supports a dark-room grue death, a sword, or a trophy-case score. Most steps were wasted: Behind House↔Clearing shuttles, West House↔North House trips, forest cycling, mailbox toggles and egg take/drop loops. Next time, try the open window much earlier, and avoid unexplored exits that show a creature.

positives: Open the Behind House window early, then go west into the Kitchen (+10); this was only found after roughly 200 low-value steps.
Light the lantern and carry it before descending; this episode's trap-door descent with light scored +25 in the Cellar.
From the Kitchen, go west to the Living Room, push the rug, open the trap door, then go down.
Check the score after each action and record which exact action produced a gain, such as taking the egg for +5.
Break a no-score streak by switching to untried verbs on visible objects, such as open, examine or take, not more movement.
After 10 steps with no score change, list untested features of the current room before leaving it.
Use room ids to tell same-named rooms apart, such as Clearing #74 and #143, before treating a destination as new.
Before entering a room newly reached from the Cellar, read its exits and objects, and weigh the risk before committing.
negatives: Do not move north from the Cellar again without a plan; the −10 terminal event followed that move into a Troll Room with a troll.
Do not shuttle Behind House and Clearing; east-west repeated many times and produced no score or new room.
Do not shuttle West House and North House or South House; these loops repeated and consumed many steps.
Do not cycle Clearing, Forest, Forest Path and 'go around forest' or 'go around trees'; these only revisit known rooms.
Do not toggle the mailbox open and closed repeatedly; every repeat produced no score or new route.
Do not repeatedly take, drop or put the egg in the mailbox or nest; these gave no score and the egg ended up damaged.
Do not keep chasing a 'previously productive' action by pure navigation when the prerequisite action, such as opening the window, has not been done.
Do not assume unsupported causes or points, such as grue deaths, sword blame or trophy-case scores, without text evidence from this episode.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Taken.
Done.
Done.

episodes.historian_review: Strongest decisions: the Actor reached the Kitchen (+10, recorded on west from Behind House) and went down through the opened trap door (+25, recorded in the Living Room). It retreated south after the troll visits and survived them. Missed opportunities: it did not check the lantern's dwindling fuel until it was nearly out, and it did not examine the Studio or Gallery for objects beyond movement. Ineffective behavior: for most of the visible trajectory it shuttled Cellar, East Chasm, Gallery and Studio, and the stale 'take egg at Up a Tree' goal was repeated about 15 times without a reachable route. It also shuffled inventory items, and the final move west from East Chasm in the dark ended in a grue death (-10). The supplied notes about a troll death and an early window loop are not supported by this truncated trajectory. Advice: check the light before every move, drop stale goals after one failed attempt, and examine objects instead of looping rooms.

positives: Check the lantern's remaining fuel before each move once it is lit, and return to lit, known rooms before it runs out.
When a recorded goal's location is unreachable or unmapped, drop it after one failed attempt instead of re-selecting it.
Open the Behind House window before trying to enter it; the recorded Kitchen +10 followed 'west' once the window was open.
Open the trap door and carry a lit lantern before descending; the recorded Cellar +25 followed a descent with light.
Retreat to the previous room after seeing a hostile occupant; the Actor survived two Troll visits that way.
Break a no-score streak of 10 steps by examining objects or testing untried verbs, not by repeating known moves.
Use room ids to tell same-named rooms apart before treating a destination as new.
Credit a score gain only to the exact action and observation that recorded it, and log it.
negatives: Do not make a dark-room move such as west from East Chasm with a nearly empty lantern; this ended in the grue death (-10).
Do not loop Cellar, East Chasm, Gallery and Studio; dozens of repeats produced no score and no new room.
Do not re-select the 'take egg at Up a Tree' goal repeatedly when the route has stalled and the prerequisites are unmet.
Do not keep taking, dropping and rearranging lunch, pepper, garlic and sack without a stated reason; these gave no score.
Do not toggle between Kitchen and Attic or Kitchen and Living Room as pure movement when nothing changed.
Do not blame an untested cause, such as a grue or troll, unless this episode's text shows it.
Do not give items to the thief or take scenery such as the chimney without a purpose; neither produced score.
Do not trust summaries over the room text; verify score, location and light from the latest observation before choosing a goal.

episodes.historian_review: Confirmed score: Kitchen +10 (west after opening the window), Cellar +25 (down, trap door open, lantern held), painting +4 (take art at Gallery). That totals 39 in 22 steps. Strongest Actor choices: opening the window before entering, taking the lantern, pushing the rug and opening the trap door before descending, and lighting the lantern on arrival. Symbolic navigation returned home cleanly via Studio up to Kitchen (step 21). Weaknesses: four forest moves detoured from the Living Room goal, the stale 'take egg at Up a Tree' goal kept steering without reaching the tree, the leaflet was never read, and Gallery/East Chasm shuttling wasted steps. The +6 deposit, grue death and ~300-step loops are not in this trace, which ends at 'open case' with 0 delta, so treat them as unverified here. Lantern fuel is a constraint. Next: deposit the painting, verify the score, drop stale goals, and check light before any dark move.

positives: Open the Behind House window before entering; the recorded Kitchen +10 followed 'west' once the window was open.
Take the lantern, push the rug and open the trap door before descending; Cellar +25 followed that descent.
Light the lantern immediately on reaching a dark room, then re-check fuel before each further move.
Once the painting is held, go straight home (Gallery, Studio, up to Kitchen, west) and deposit it, verifying the score.
Drop a stale goal after one failed attempt, such as 'take egg at Up a Tree' when the tree was never reached.
Read items you open, such as the mailbox leaflet, before leaving; text clues are cheap and unused.
Use room ids to tell same-named rooms apart, and treat the verified home route as the safe fallback.
Credit score only to the exact action and observation that recorded it, and log the before and after score.
negatives: Do not move into a dark room with a nearly empty lantern; a reported grue death (-10) came from such a move.
Do not shuttle Gallery and East Chasm, or Cellar and East Chasm, without a new objective; these repeats gave no score.
Do not keep a goal whose target room is unreached; the egg goal steered the actions for many steps without progress.
Do not wander the forest while the goal is the Living Room; four such moves gave no score.
Do not open the mailbox and leave without reading the leaflet; the clue went unused.
Do not assume a hostile occupant makes an exit lethal; the troll only blocked Cellar north, per the corrected note.
Do not take and drop lunch, pepper, garlic or sack without a stated reason; none produced score.
Do not trust the planner's 'previously productive' gain figures over the latest observation; verify score, location and light first.

episodes.historian_review: Confirmed in this 14-step trace: Kitchen +10 (west after opening the window), Cellar +25 (down), then death (-10) moving north in the dark Cellar. The final score was 25. The strongest decisions were the window, rug and trap-door sequence, though only the two recorded events earn credit. Missed: no lantern was taken or lit before descending, and the leaflet was taken but never read. The four-move forest detour and the 'take egg' goal, which never reached the tree, were ineffective. Supplied notes, not visible in this trace, add painting +4, case +6, a low-lantern grue death, a reopenable trap door, a verified Studio-up-Kitchen route, and ~300 steps of Cellar/East Chasm and Gallery/Studio looping. Treat these as unverified here. The troll only blocks Cellar north; darkness killed the agent. Next time: confirm light and fuel before every move, and drop stale goals.

positives: Open the Behind House window, then go west; the recorded Kitchen +10 followed that move.
Push the rug and open the trap door before descending; Cellar +25 was recorded on 'down'.
Secure a light source and check lantern fuel before descending or entering any dark room.
Use the reopenable trap door and the verified Studio-up-Kitchen route as the safe return path.
Retire a goal after one failed attempt, such as 'take egg' when the tree was never reached.
Read items you take, such as the leaflet, before dropping them or moving on.
Use room ids to tell same-named rooms apart, and note the exits seen in each.
Log score before and after each action, and credit only the exact recorded event.
negatives: Do not move in a dark room without light or enough fuel; both recorded grue deaths (-10) came from such moves.
Do not shuttle Cellar/East Chasm or Gallery/Studio without a new objective; about 300 such steps gave no score.
Do not keep a goal whose target room is unreached; the egg goal steered actions without progress.
Do not wander the forest while the stated goal is the Living Room; those moves scored nothing.
Do not drop inventory items in the dark without a reason; dropping the leaflet helped nothing.
Do not treat the troll room as lethal; the troll only blocks Cellar north.
Do not trust the planner's 'previously productive' gain figures over the latest observation; verify score, location and light first.
Do not descend with unfinished prerequisites; the trap door shuts behind you and leaves you in the dark.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

Cellar
You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading north, and a crawlway to the south. On the west is the bottom of a steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
Taken.
Done.

episodes.historian_review: Strongest decisions: opening the window then going west (Kitchen +10 recorded), lighting and taking the lantern, and pushing the rug and opening the trap door before descending (Cellar +25 on 'down'). In the Gallery, 'take art' (+4) and 'put painting in case' (+6) are also recorded events. Symbolic navigation home (Gallery, Studio, Kitchen, Living Room) worked and was verified. Ineffective: the first ~5 moves looped through the forest. The Actor then clung to a stale 'take egg' goal and shuttled Cellar/East Chasm about 25 steps for 0 points. The trap door crashed shut behind the first descent. Fatal: moving north into the Troll Room; the troll knocked the agent out (-10), ending the run at 35. Earlier visits survived, so the room is not safe. Note: the brief's 'no lantern, grue death' conflicts with the log. Next: bank score, then pursue one new unexplored exit; avoid the Troll Room.

positives: Open the Behind House window, then go west; the recorded Kitchen +10 followed that move.
Push the rug and open the trap door before descending; Cellar +25 was recorded on 'down'.
Take and light the lantern before any descent or dark room, and check it is still on.
Return a carried painting to the Living Room trophy case; 'put painting in case' recorded +6.
Check the Gallery (via East Chasm east) for takeable items; 'take art' recorded +4 there.
Use the verified return route Gallery→Studio→Kitchen→Living Room when carrying valuables.
Retire a goal after one failed attempt or when its target room is unreached, such as 'take egg'.
Read the score and location after each action; credit only the exact recorded event.
negatives: Do not enter the Troll Room: the troll knocked the agent out (-10) and ended the episode at 35.
Do not shuttle Cellar/East Chasm without a new objective; about 25 steps here gave no score.
Do not open with forest loops (west, east, around forest); about 5 early moves scored nothing.
Do not keep the 'take egg' goal while the Up a Tree room is unreached.
Do not assume a room is safe because an earlier visit survived; the fourth Troll Room entry was fatal.
Do not descend before prerequisites are done; the trap door crashes shut behind you.
Do not trust planner 'previously productive' gain figures over the latest observation; verify score and location.
Do not repeat a move that has just failed to reveal anything; try an untested exit or action instead.

On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Taken.

episodes.historian_review: Strongest play: the Actor opened the window and went west (Kitchen +10 recorded), took the lantern, pushed the rug, opened the trap door and went down (Cellar +25), and took the painting at the Gallery (+4). The Studio 'up' route to the Kitchen is verified, and symbolic navigation then returned it to the Living Room cleanly. Missed opportunity: it used 'put down painting' instead of putting it in the trophy case, so no case-deposit score was observed. This contradicts the +6 case-deposit claim, which I could not credit. Ineffective: about 25 steps shuttling between Cellar, East Chasm and Gallery, and repeated stale 'take egg' goals. The Troll room was entered once and survived, so its lethality is unverified. The -10 death came from 'jump' at East Chasm, not from the troll. Next time: bank treasure in the case, retire stale goals, and avoid risky verbs.

positives: Open the Behind House window, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move.
Take the lantern, push the rug, open the trap door, then 'down'; Cellar +25 was recorded. Light the lantern immediately below.
'take art' at the Gallery recorded +4; carry it north to the Studio, up to the Kitchen, west to the Living Room.
In the Living Room, use 'put painting in trophy case' rather than 'put down'; an earlier episode recorded +6, so verify the score.
Read score and location after each action and credit only exactly recorded score events.
Retire a goal after one failed attempt or when its target room is unreached, such as 'take egg'.
When the score stalls, test one untried exit or object at a time instead of re-walking mapped rooms.
Examine items found along the way (sack, bottle, manual, attic contents) before leaving a room, but verify they matter before carrying them.
negatives: Do not type 'jump' at East Chasm; it killed the agent (-10) and ended the run at 29.
Do not shuttle Cellar/East Chasm/Gallery without a new objective; about 25 steps scored nothing.
Do not drop a treasure with 'put down' in the Living Room; the painting stayed there unbanked and scored nothing.
Do not keep the 'take egg' goal while Up a Tree is unreached; it recurred in many planner goals without progress.
Do not open with forest loops (west, east, around forest); about 5 early moves scored nothing.
Do not treat the Troll room as safe or as proven lethal: one visit was survived, so enter only deliberately, armed or with a plan.
Do not trust planner 'previously productive' gain figures over the latest observation; verify score and location.
Do not re-descend empty-handed or repeat a stalled move; first bank carried valuables and choose an untested action.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

East-West Passage
This is a narrow east-west passageway. There is a narrow stairway leading down at the north end of the room.
Taken.

episodes.historian_review: Actor performance: the opening was efficient. It opened the window and went west (Kitchen +10 recorded). It took the lantern and sword, pushed the rug, opened the trap door and went down (Cellar +25 recorded). It lit the lantern, killed the troll with the sword, and the next move east recorded +5. 'take bar' in the Loud Room recorded +10. The final score was 40: +50 earned, then -10 on death. The supplied notes about a 'jump' death and a painting don't match this log, so I credited neither. The death was drowning in the Maintenance Room. The Actor pushed the buttons, water rose from shin to neck, and it kept re-entering. It also spent roughly 35 steps cycling Chasm, North-South Passage, Round Room, Deep Canyon and Loud Room while carrying the bar, never verifying a route home, and the egg goal never ran. Next time: bank the bar, and leave rising-water hazards immediately.

positives: Open the Behind House window, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move.
Take lantern and sword, push rug, open trap door, go down; Cellar +25 was recorded. Light the lantern immediately.
In the Troll room, 'hit troll with sword' killed the troll; the later east move to East-West Passage recorded +5.
In the Loud Room, 'take bar' recorded +10; it was reached via Deep Canyon, down.
Read score and location after each action; credit only exactly recorded score events.
After taking a treasure, head straight back along a confirmed route toward the Living Room trophy case and verify the score.
When a route search stalls, log exits already tried per room and test one untried exit instead of repeating moves.
Heed hazard messages (rising water, darkness) as stop signals: leave the room and rethink before any further interaction.
negatives: Do not push buttons in the Maintenance Room; the blue button began flooding, the water rose to the neck, and drowning ended the run (-10, final 40).
Do not re-enter or linger in a room with rising water; the Actor returned repeatedly and kept pressing buttons.
Do not cycle Chasm/North-South Passage/Round Room/Deep Canyon/Loud Room; about 35 steps scored nothing.
Do not carry treasure deeper underground without a verified route home; home return was never confirmed this episode.
Do not keep the 'take egg' planner goal; it recurred many times, and the Up a Tree room was never reached.
Do not open with forest loops (west, east, go around forest); about 4 early moves scored nothing.
Do not trust planner 'previously productive' gain figures (+200, +15); verify against the latest score and location.
Do not light matches or squeeze tubes at random as time pressure grows; each untested action must have a stated purpose.

Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.

episodes.historian_review: Strongest play: the Actor opened the window and went west (Kitchen +10 recorded on that move). It then took the lantern, pushed the rug, opened the trap door and went down (Cellar +25 recorded), and lit the lantern. Missed opportunities: it took no sword and never checked for a weapon. It re-entered the Troll room five times with nothing to answer the troll. The last entry ended the run: the troll knocked the Actor out, with -10 recorded and a final score of 25. Wasted moves: about 5 early steps on the mailbox and forest, and about 4 shuffling Kitchen and Living Room. Symbolic navigation was reliable, with every transition confirmed, but its stale 'take egg' and 'take bar' goals pushed the Actor toward places it could not reach. Next time: arm up before the troll, treat a blocked room as a stop signal, and ignore stale goals. This evidence shows no East-West Passage, platinum bar or Maintenance Room events, so those earlier-run facts are not credited here.

positives: Open the Behind House window, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move again this episode.
Take lantern, push rug, open trap door, go down; Cellar +25 was recorded. Light the lantern immediately on arrival.
Before the Troll room, check inventory for a weapon; an earlier run killed the troll with the sword, so fetch it first.
Read score and location after every action; credit only score events that are recorded exactly.
Keep a per-room list of exits tried, and test one untried exit instead of repeating a blocked move.
Treat hostile blockers, darkness and rising water as stop signals: leave, rethink, and prepare before re-engaging.
Earlier run: after taking treasure, return along a confirmed route to the Living Room trophy case and verify the score.
Override stale planner goals when the current room and inventory do not match; state a purpose for each untested action.
negatives: Do not enter the Troll room unarmed again; the troll knocked the Actor out and the run ended with -10 (final 25).
Do not shuttle Cellar and Troll; five entries gained nothing, and the last one was fatal.

Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Taken.
Done.

East-West Passage
This is a narrow east-west passageway. There is a narrow stairway leading down at the north end of the room.
Taken.

episodes.historian_review:
Strongest decisions: the Actor eventually took the sword, killed the troll, banked the Gallery painting (+6 recorded on the deposit, +4 on taking it), and took the Loud Room bar (+10 recorded). Kitchen +10 and Cellar +25 were recorded on the window-entry west move and the trap-door down. Symbolic navigation (steps 33-36 home return) worked cleanly.

Ineffective: the mailbox/forest detour (~5 steps), about 15 steps shuttling Cellar/Troll/East Chasm unarmed, stale egg/bar planner chasing, never banking the bar, and ~35 steps in Dam Lobby/Maintenance Room (matches, tube, buttons, bolt) with no score. The briefed death (-10) is not supported: one axe hit occurred, but the run ended at 60 with no_safe_actions. Advice: arm before the troll, bank treasure immediately, and stop any loop after two repeats.

positives: Open the Behind House window, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move.
Take lantern, push rug, open trap door, go down; Cellar +25 was recorded. Light the lantern on arrival.
Take the sword from the Living Room before the Troll room; with it, one hit killed the troll and the east passage opened.
Gallery painting: take art (+4 recorded), return via confirmed Studio-Kitchen-Living Room route, open case, put painting in case (+6 recorded).
Verified route onward: Troll east (+5 recorded), then north, south, northeast, down reached the Loud Room, where taking the bar recorded +10.
Read score and location after every action; credit only score events that are actually recorded.
After taking a treasure, bank it in the Living Room trophy case before exploring further, and verify the score change.
Override stale planner goals when room and inventory do not match; state a concrete purpose before each untested action.
negatives: Do not enter the Troll room unarmed; the axe hit the Actor when it tried to leave north. Fetch the sword first.
Do not shuttle Cellar, Troll and East Chasm without a new purpose; about 15 early steps scored nothing.
Do not chase planner goals like 'take egg' without a verified route; Up a Tree was never reached despite repeated hints.
Do not open with mailbox and forest loops; about 5 early moves scored nothing.
Do not wander with an unbanked treasure; the bar was held for about 40 steps in the Dam area and never deposited.
Do not cycle Dam Lobby and Maintenance Room; matches, tube, yellow button and bolt gave no score. An earlier run's flood was not re-observed.
Do not trust planner 'previously productive' gain figures (+250, +15); this run's Cellar event was only +25.
Do not repeat blocked moves or loop Chasm, North-South Passage, Round Room, Deep Canyon and Loud Room; try one untried exit instead.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

episodes.historian_review: Strongest decisions: opening the window and going west (Kitchen +10 recorded on that move), then taking the sword, pushing the rug, opening the trap door and going down (Cellar +25 recorded). Navigation was clean, with no blocked or repeated moves. Ineffective: the first four moves (west, east, go around forest, west) scored nothing. Planner hints about the egg and bar pointed at unreached targets, and the Actor's notes kept echoing them. Fatal error: it descended without the lantern, then moved north in pitch darkness and a grue killed it (-10, final score 25). Its note expected the Troll room, but that was never observed. Correction to the premises: the evidence shows no axe death, no Troll visits and no missing sword. Next time: take lantern and sword, check inventory before the trap door, light the lantern on arrival, and read the observation before moving.

positives: Open the Behind House window, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move.
Take lantern, push rug, open trap door, go down; Cellar +25 was recorded. Light the lantern before any move in the Cellar.
Take the sword from the Living Room before going down; it was confirmed taken this run. Earlier evidence: with it, one hit killed the troll.
Check inventory right before descending: confirm both lantern and sword are held, since the trap door crashes shut behind you.
Gallery painting: take art (+4 recorded), return via the Studio-Kitchen-Living Room route, open case, put painting in case (+6 recorded).
Verified route onward: Troll east (+5 recorded), then north, south, northeast, down reached the Loud Room, where taking the bar recorded +10.
Read score and location after every action and credit only recorded score events; death recorded -10 this run.
Bank treasures in the Living Room trophy case before exploring further, and verify the score change. State a concrete purpose before each untested action.
negatives: Do not make any move in a pitch-black room; the first move north from the unlit Cellar brought a grue death (-10).
Do not go down the trap door without the lantern in inventory; this run took only the sword and died in the dark.
Do not assume a destination; the Actor expected the Troll room but the observation was a grue death. Read the observation first.
Do not open with forest or mailbox loops; west, east, go around forest, west cost 4 moves and scored nothing this run.
Do not chase planner goals like 'take egg' or 'take bar' without a verified route; no such location was reached this run.
Do not trust planner gain figures (+275, +15, +20); this run's Cellar event was only +25. Treat them as unverified.
Do not wander with an unbanked treasure; an earlier run held the bar about 40 steps and never deposited it.
Do not loop Dam Lobby, Maintenance Room, Chasm, Round Room or Loud Room, or repeat blocked moves; the flood and loop notes are from earlier runs, not re-observed.

You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

Cellar
You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading north, and a crawlway to the south. On the west is the bottom of a steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

episodes.historian_review: The evidence conflicts with the briefing: the trajectory shows the lantern taken and lit, no sword taken, and death by the troll's axe in the Troll room at step 20 (-10), not a grue. Strongest decisions: open window then west (Kitchen +10 recorded), and lantern on, push rug, open trap, down (Cellar +25 recorded). Missed: no weapon taken and no inventory check before descending. Ineffective: the west/east/forest/west loop wasted 4 steps; four Cellar-Troll shuttles scored nothing; the final 'take walls' beside the troll was pointless. Stale hints (egg, bar, Living Room 'down') drove the detours. Navigation was mostly confirmed, so the failure was Actor judgment. Next time: check inventory before descending, retreat from the troll, and test hints against the observation. Maintenance buttons were not re-observed.

positives: Open the Behind House window, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move.
Take and light the lantern before going down; the Cellar +25 was recorded and this kept the Cellar lit.
Verified edges: Behind House west to Kitchen, Kitchen west to Living Room, Living Room down to Cellar (trap door then shuts).
Check inventory just before descending: the trap door shuts behind you, so confirm light and a weapon are held first.
Read score, location and observation after every action, and credit only recorded score events; this death recorded -10.
State a concrete purpose before each untested action, and verify the score change afterward.
When a room's observation shows a threat, treat it as new evidence and choose a safer action than the planner's goal.
Bank treasures in the Living Room trophy case before exploring further, and verify the score change on deposit.
negatives: Do not move in a pitch-black room; an earlier run died to a grue on the first move north from the unlit Cellar.
Do not shuttle Cellar-Troll repeatedly; four round trips scored 0, and the troll room ended in death at step 20.
Do not stay in the Troll room taking aimless actions like 'take walls'; leave or act on a concrete threat assessment.
Do not enter the Troll room without checking that you hold a weapon; this run went in unarmed and died.
Do not open with the west/east/go-around-forest loop; it cost 4 steps and scored nothing.
Do not chase stale planner goals ('take egg', 'take bar', Living Room 'down') without a verified route and matching observation.
Do not trust planner gain figures (+300, +15, +20); the observed Cellar event was only +25.
Do not rely on old notes about Maintenance buttons or the dam area; they were not re-observed this run.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Taken.
Done.

episodes.historian_review:
Strongest decisions: opening the window and going west (Kitchen +10 recorded on that move), taking and lighting the lantern before descending (Cellar +25 recorded on 'down'), and banking the painting (+6 recorded on 'put painting in case'; +4 on 'take art'). Symbolic navigation returned home cleanly in four steps. Caveat: the briefing's troll-axe death does not match the log, which shows a thief killing the Actor at East Chasm (-10, step 41, final score 35).

Weaknesses: the opening west/east/forest loop (4 steps, 0 points), three Troll/Cellar round trips scoring nothing, and stale egg/bar/'down' hints driving detours. The fatal choice was attacking the thief, then picking up the dropped sword mid-fight instead of retreating. Next time: treat a hostile NPC as a hard override of the planner goal, avoid melee, and check each hint against the current room.

positives: Open the Behind House window, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move.
Take and light the lantern before descending; Cellar +25 was recorded and the lantern kept the Cellar lit.
Verified edges: Behind House west to Kitchen, Kitchen west to Living Room, Living Room down to Cellar (trap door then shuts).
Once a treasure is held, return home and deposit it; 'put painting in case' recorded +6 after the trip.
Check score and observation after every action and credit only recorded score events; 'take art' recorded +4.
Test one transition at a time and verify the room name afterward; symbolic homeward routing completed cleanly this run.
Carry a light source before leaving the Living Room, and check inventory before descending since the trap door shuts behind you.
When an observation shows a hostile character, treat it as new evidence and choose retreat or avoidance over the planner's goal.
negatives: Do not open with the west/east/go-around-forest loop; it cost 4 steps and scored 0.
Do not shuttle Cellar/Troll or Cellar/East Chasm repeatedly; three Troll round trips scored 0.
Do not chase stale planner goals ('take egg', 'take bar', Living Room 'down') without a verified route and matching observation.
Do not trust planner gain figures (+325, +15, +20); the observed Cellar event was +25.
Do not start melee with a thief or troll; the Actor died to the thief at East Chasm (-10, step 41).
Do not pick up a dropped weapon while an enemy is still attacking; this 'take sword' ended the run.
Do not type aimless actions like 'take walls' in a dangerous room; leave or act on a concrete threat assessment.
Do not rely on old notes about Maintenance buttons or the dam area; they were not re-observed this run.

episodes.historian_review: The supplied evidence conflicts with the death summary. It shows 40 points in 29 steps, ending in a no_safe_actions stop at the Loud Room, with no thief, Gallery, or death. I judged the Actor on the logged trajectory. Strongest decisions: opening the window and going west (+10 on that move), taking the lantern and sword, opening the trap door, and going down (+25 on that move). The sword kill of the troll was confirmed, and +5 was recorded on the later move east, so I don't credit the kill itself. Weaknesses: about nine opening steps of mailbox, North House and forest wandering scored 0, and Kitchen/Living Room shuttling wasted more. It then explored on with no treasure, never verified a route home, and used 'echo' beside the visible bar instead of a concrete action. Next time: go straight to the verified route, act on visible objects, and keep a way home.

positives: Open the Behind House window, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move.
Take the lantern, turn it on, and carry the sword before descending; Cellar +25 was recorded on 'down'.
Verified route: Behind House west, Kitchen west, push rug, open trap door, then down to the Cellar; the trap door shuts behind you.
Verified underground edges: Cellar north to Troll, east to East-West Passage, north to Chasm, south to North-South Passage, then northeast to Deep Canyon.
From Deep Canyon, 'down' reaches the Loud Room, where a platinum bar was observed on the ground; take visible items before experimenting.
'hit troll with sword' killed the troll in one action; +5 appeared on the next move east, so credit only recorded events.
Check the score and observation after every action; credit only recorded score events, never planner estimates.
Before leaving a room carrying a valuable, note and test a route back to the Living Room, and deposit treasures in the case.
negatives: Do not open with mailbox, North House, west/east forest or 'go around forest' wandering; about nine early steps scored 0.
Do not shuttle Kitchen/Living Room or Cellar/Troll without a new reason; repeated back-and-forth moves scored nothing.
Do not chase stale planner hints ('take egg', 'take bar', Living Room 'down') unless the observation confirms the object and a route exists.
Do not trust planner gain figures (+350, +15, +20); the observed events were +10, +25 and +5.
Do not spend a turn on 'echo' or other aimless commands when a visible object, such as the bar, can be examined or taken.
Do not push deeper underground carrying nothing of value and with no verified path home; the home return was never confirmed.
Do not start melee with a thief (an earlier report, not re-observed here, says it ended in death at East Chasm); retreat instead.
Do not pick up a dropped weapon while an enemy is still attacking; reassess first, and do not assume the thief is avoidable.

episodes.historian_review:
The supplied trace confirms only Kitchen +10, recorded on 'west' after 'open window' (15 steps, ending in no_safe_actions). The brief's Cellar +25, Gallery +4, deposit +6 and thief death (-10, 41 steps) are not in this trace, so they are briefed rather than independently verified.

Strongest decisions: opening the window and entering, taking the lantern, and lighting it in the dark Attic. Ineffective: the mailbox/leaflet opening, the forest loop (about five zero-score moves), and Kitchen/Living Room/Attic detours driven by stale 'down' and 'take egg' hints. The brief also notes about six Cellar/Troll repeats. It records that the Actor attacked the thief with the sword, the sword slipped, and 'take sword' under attack was fatal. Advice: skip the forest, descend with lantern and sword, avoid thief melee, retreat instead of re-grabbing a weapon, and carry valuables home by verified edges.

positives: Open the Behind House window, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move.
Take the lantern, light it, and carry the sword before descending; Cellar +25 was recorded on the descent.
Verified route home: Cellar south to East Chasm, east to Gallery, north to Studio, up to Kitchen. Reuse it when carrying valuables.
Gallery 'take art' recorded +4 and the trophy-case deposit recorded +6. Carry valuables home and deposit them.
Check score and observation after every action; credit only recorded score events, never planner estimates.
Light the lantern before dark rooms such as the Attic; this worked without incident.
When an attack or weapon slip occurs, step away through a verified exit and reassess before issuing another combat command.
Earlier reports list underground edges from Cellar: north to Troll, east to East-West Passage. Treat them as candidates and verify before relying on them.
negatives: Do not open with mailbox, leaflet or forest wandering ('west', 'east', 'go around forest'); about five early moves scored 0.
Do not shuttle Cellar/Troll (about 6 repeats) or Kitchen/Living Room without a new observation or goal.
Do not chase stale hints ('take egg', 'take bar', Living Room 'down') unless the object is observed and a route exists.
Do not trust planner gain figures (+375, +15); the observed events were +10, +25, +4 and +6.
Do not attack the thief with the sword at East Chasm; the sword slipped and the Actor died (-10).
Do not 'take sword' or any dropped weapon while the thief is still attacking.
Do not treat the troll fight as solved; it was not verified this episode, and thief avoidability is also unverified.
Do not spend turns on aimless commands or low-value detours (Attic, 'echo') while the known underground route remains unexplored.

episodes.historian_review: Note: the supplied summary (Gallery, thief, 41 steps) does not match this trajectory. The recorded run lasted 15 steps and ended in a grue death in the Cellar, so I assess that run only. Strongest decisions: open window then west (Kitchen +10 recorded on that move), and push rug, open trap, down (Cellar +25 recorded on that move). Weaknesses: the first eight moves (mailbox, leaflet, North House, forest loop) scored 0. The Actor descended without a lantern, then typed 'north' in pitch black and died (-10, final 25). Stale egg/bar/'down' hints drove detours. Navigation was confirmed; the fatal choice was an Actor decision. Next time: secure and light a lantern before descending, never move in darkness, and go straight to the window. Troll and thief outcomes remain unverified.

positives: Open the Behind House window, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move again this episode.
From Living Room: push rug, open trap door, go down. Cellar +25 was recorded on that descent, in about four moves after the Kitchen.
Before descending, hold a light source and light it; this run descended without one, and the trap door shut behind.
If an observation says pitch black, make producing light the only priority; issue no movement commands.
Check score after every action; credit only recorded events (Kitchen +10, Cellar +25), never planner estimates.
Earlier-episode route, unverified here: Cellar south to East Chasm, east to Gallery, north to Studio, up to Kitchen. Re-verify each step.
Earlier-episode records: Gallery 'take art' +4 and trophy-case deposit +6. Carry valuables home and deposit them.
If a weapon slips or an attacker appears, retreat through a verified exit and reassess before further combat commands.
negatives: Do not open with mailbox, leaflet or forest wandering; about eight early moves scored 0 this episode.
Do not move in pitch darkness; 'north' from the Cellar without light ended in a grue death (-10).
Do not descend through the trap door without a lit lantern in inventory; the door crashes shut behind you.
Do not chase stale hints ('take egg', 'take bar', Loud Room) unless the object is observed and a route exists.
Do not trust planner gain figures (+375, +15, +20); observed events were +10 and +25, then -10 on death.
Do not shuttle Cellar/Troll or Kitchen/Living Room (about 6 repeats earlier) without a new observation or goal.

episodes.historian_review: The Actor's best play was entering the Kitchen via the opened window (+10 recorded on that move), taking the lantern, and opening the trap door. The descent recorded Cellar +25. It lit the lantern right after arriving in the dark and survived. It took the painting (+4 at Gallery) and, after symbolic navigation returned it to the Living Room, deposited it (+6). The supplied death summary (unlit descent, grue) does not match the trajectory: the lantern was held and lit, and the death came from the troll. Missed opportunities: four opening moves were a forest loop worth 0. After step 23 nothing scored for about 50 steps. The Actor shuttled Cellar/Troll/East Chasm roughly 25 times and chased stale 'down', 'take egg' and 'take bar' goals. The fatal move was 'give troll garlic' (-10): an axe killed the Actor at step 73. Next time, bank treasure, then test unexplored exits, and leave the troll alone.

positives: Open the Behind House window, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move again this episode.
In the Living Room: take lantern, push rug, open trap door, go down. Cellar +25 was recorded on the descent.
Light the lantern before descending if possible; arrival was pitch black until lit, and the trap door shut behind (hypothesis: safer pre-lit).
Verified route: Cellar south to East Chasm, east to Gallery, north to Studio, up to Kitchen, west to Living Room.
Gallery 'take art' gave +4 and 'open case', 'put painting in case' gave +6; carry valuables home and deposit them.
Check score after every action; credit only recorded events, never planner gain estimates.
After banking a treasure, pick one unexplored exit or unexamined object and test it, rather than replaying earlier score hints.
In pitch black, light the lantern before any movement command; if the lantern is lost or unlit, stop and fix that first.
negatives: Do not open with the forest loop (west, east, go around forest, west); four early moves scored 0.
Do not shuttle Cellar/Troll/East Chasm (about 25 moves here) without a new observation or goal; it scored nothing.
Do not 'give troll garlic' or otherwise provoke the Troll; the axe killed the Actor (-10, step 73). The troll remains unsolved.
Do not chase stale goal hints ('down', 'take egg', 'take bar'); after the Cellar, none produced score or a reachable object.
Do not trust planner gain figures (+400, +15, +20); observed events were +10, +25, +4, +6, then -10.
Do not move in pitch darkness; an earlier episode ended in a grue death after moving north without light.
Do not collect items (food, garlic, sack, pepper) without a stated observed purpose, and do not hand them to hostile creatures.
Do not treat the thief as solved: giving lunch made it leave, but the outcome is unverified; an earlier sword attack killed the Actor.

Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.

A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:

You have moved into a dark place.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Taken.

episodes.historian_review: Strongest decisions: the Actor opened the window and entered the Kitchen (+10), then took the lantern, pushed the rug, opened the trap door and descended (+25). It lit the lantern right after arriving in the Cellar and took the art in the Gallery (+4). Its navigation transitions were reliable. Missed opportunities: it never carried the art home, never tested Studio 'up', and never found a use for the manual. Ineffective behavior: a four-move forest loop, then about 40 moves shuttling Cellar/East Chasm/Troll/Gallery/Studio while chasing stale 'take bar', 'take egg' and 'down' hints. It dropped and retook the art, which scored 0. The episode ended at 29 (not 35) after a fourth northward entry into the unarmed Troll room, which cost -10. The brief's 'give troll garlic', painting-in-case +6 and lunch-to-thief are not in this episode's log. Advice: bank valuables first, treat the Troll room as lethal, and ignore stale hints.

positives: Open the Behind House window, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move again this episode.
In the Living Room: take lantern, push rug, open trap door, go down. Cellar +25 was recorded on the descent.
Turn on the lantern immediately on reaching the Cellar; the arrival was pitch black and the trap door shut behind you.
Confirmed this episode: Cellar south to East Chasm, East Chasm east to Gallery, Gallery north to Studio. Studio up to Kitchen is untested here.
Gallery 'take art' gave +4. Carry it home along a verified route and put it in the case, checking the score afterward.
Check the score after every action and credit only recorded score events, never planner gain estimates.
Once a valuable is in hand, head home by a verified route before exploring; test Studio 'up' as the likely way back to the Kitchen.
After a stalled goal, pick one untested exit or unexamined object and try it, rather than replaying earlier score hints.
negatives: Do not open with the forest loop (west, east, go around forest, west); four early moves scored 0.
Do not shuttle Cellar/East Chasm/Troll/Gallery/Studio (about 40 moves) without a new observation or goal; it scored nothing.
Do not enter the Troll room without a weapon. Entering from the Cellar killed the Actor (-10); an earlier giving-garlic attempt was also fatal.
Do not chase stale goal hints ('down', 'take egg', 'take bar'); after the Cellar, none produced score or a reachable object.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Taken.

episodes.historian_review: The Actor opened the window and went west (+10 on that move), took the lantern, pushed the rug, opened the trap door and went down (+25), lit the lantern, and took the art in the Gallery (+4). That opening was efficient. Weaknesses: about 7 early moves in a forest loop, and about 35 moves shuttling Cellar/East Chasm/Gallery/Studio with the art. It never tried 'up' in the Studio, never examined anything there, and twice dropped and retook the art for no reason. Only 2 actions were symbolic navigation (East Chasm east, Gallery north), and both were correct; the Actor's own choices caused the stall. The trajectory shows the fatal -10 came from 'jump' at East Chasm. The Troll visit (north, then south) cost nothing. Next time: try Studio 'up' immediately, and avoid risky verbs near chasms.

positives: Open the Behind House window, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move in this episode and in earlier ones.
In the Living Room: take lantern, push rug, open trap door, go down. Cellar +25 was recorded on the descent.
Light the lantern right after reaching the Cellar; arrival was pitch black and the trap door shuts behind you.
Verified edges: Cellar south to East Chasm, East Chasm east to Gallery, Gallery north to Studio, Kitchen west to Living Room.
Gallery 'take art' gave +4. After taking a treasure, head straight to untested exits that could lead home.
From the Studio, try 'up' first; it is the untested candidate route back to the Kitchen and was never tried.
Check the score after every action and credit only recorded score events, never planner gain estimates.
When a goal stalls, test one unused exit or examine one object (e.g. the Studio paper) rather than re-walking known rooms.
negatives: Never type 'jump' at East Chasm or any chasm edge; it killed the Actor (-10). Avoid untested risky verbs near drops.
Do not shuttle Cellar/East Chasm/Gallery/Studio without a new observation; roughly 35 moves scored nothing this episode.
Avoid the Troll room, which has an armed troll. A brief entry and exit survived here, but it offers no route home.
Do not chase stale goal hints ('down', 'take egg', 'take bar'); none produced reachable score after the Cellar.
Do not trust planner gain figures (+450, +15, +20); observed events were +10, +25, +4, then -10.
Do not drop and retake a treasure (art or painting) without a purpose; each loop scored 0 and wasted moves.
Do not open with the forest loop or wander North House and forest before the window; about 7 early moves scored 0.
Do not pick up or carry items (leaflet, manual) without a stated purpose, and never give items to hostile creatures.

episodes.historian_review:
The Actor played the opening and first treasure run well. It opened the window and went west (+10), took the lantern, pushed the rug, opened the trap door and descended (+25), lit the lantern, took the art in the Gallery (+4), and later put the painting in the case (+6). Recorded scoring was +10, +25, +4, +6, then -10, ending at 35. Symbolic navigation handled the Studio→Kitchen→Living Room return, but the Actor twice stepped east and undid it.

The weakness came after banking. About 40 moves were spent on stale 'take bar'/'take egg' hints, shuttling between rooms and fiddling with the bottle, sack and rope, with no score. It then entered the Troll room a third time and died (-10). Next time: after banking, test one genuinely new exit and never re-enter the troll.

Note: the trajectory contradicts the brief's 'jump' death and 'painting never banked' claims, so I relied on the trajectory.

positives: Open the Behind House window, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move.
Living Room: take lantern, push rug, open trap door, go down for the recorded Cellar +25. Light the lantern on arrival; it is pitch black.
Verified route: Cellar S East Chasm, E Gallery, N Studio, Studio up Kitchen, Kitchen W Living Room. Gallery 'take art' recorded +4.
With a treasure in hand, go straight home: Studio up, Kitchen west, open case, put item in case. The painting gave +6.
Let a go-home navigation goal finish uninterrupted; deposit the treasure before exploring or opening anything else.
Check the score after every action and credit only recorded score events, never planner gain estimates.
After banking, spend turns on a genuinely unvisited exit or examining a specific object, not rooms already walked.
Take only items with a stated purpose; lantern use was justified by the dark Cellar and the Actor's reasoning.
negatives: Never enter the Troll room (north of Cellar). Two brief entries survived, but the third got the Actor knocked out and killed (-10, run over).
Ignore stale goal hints 'take bar', 'take egg' and 'down'; they never reached score after the Cellar and fed roughly 40 moves of looping.
Do not shuttle Cellar, East Chasm, Gallery, Studio, Kitchen and Attic without a new observation; those loops scored 0.
Do not step against a symbolic go-home route (Living Room east, twice); it delayed depositing the painting by several moves.
Do not trust planner gain figures (+475, +20, +15); observed events were +10, +25, +4, +6, then -10.
Do not open with the forest loop or wander before the window; about 5 early moves scored 0.
Do not repeatedly open the bottle or sack, or pick up the rope or other items, without a stated purpose.
Avoid 'jump' at chasm edges; an earlier lesson reported it fatal, though this run did not reproduce it. Do not test risky verbs near drops.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Taken.

episodes.historian_review: The Actor's best play was the early sequence, which the score log confirms: Kitchen +10, Cellar +25, and Gallery 'take art' +4. After that it stalled. It never tried 'up' from the Studio, the route home recorded in earlier lessons, and instead shuttled Cellar, East Chasm, Gallery and Studio for roughly 150 steps with zero score. It repeatedly dropped and re-took the art, painting, manual and leaflet, followed stale 'take bar' hints, and waited in the Cellar. Symbolic navigation moves were mostly valid; the Actor's own choices caused the loop. The episode ended with a fatal 'jump' at East Chasm (-10, final 29). The recorded evidence shows no trophy-case deposit and the Troll room was entered and exited alive, which contradicts the supplied summary. Next episode: when a route is called blocked, try each untested exit in the current room once, and never jump.

positives: Open the Behind House window, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move.
Take the lantern, open the trap door and go down for the recorded Cellar +25; light the lantern in the dark.
Verified route to Gallery: Cellar south to East Chasm, east to Gallery. 'take art' there recorded +4.
With a treasure in hand, try Studio 'up' toward Kitchen, then west to Living Room, and use the trophy case.
When the planner says a route is blocked, test each untried exit in the current room once, including up and down.
Keep a per-room list of tried exits; when every exit is exhausted, change area instead of re-walking known rooms.
Credit only recorded score events; after every action compare the score and ignore planner gain estimates.
After depositing a treasure, explore only genuinely unvisited exits and examine one specific object per new room.
negatives: Never use 'jump' at East Chasm or any edge; it killed the Actor (-10) and ended the run.
Avoid the Troll room north of the Cellar; this run entered and left it alive, but the risk is unproven and earlier lessons record a death there.
Ignore stale hints 'take bar', 'take egg' and 'down'; they scored nothing and drove about 150 steps of looping.
Do not shuttle Cellar, East Chasm, Gallery and Studio without a new observation; none of those loops scored.
Do not drop and re-take the art, painting, manual or leaflet; each cycle wasted moves and scored 0.
Do not 'wait' in the Cellar; a wandering figure appeared and nothing was gained.
Do not trust planner gain figures such as +20; the observed events were +10, +25, +4 and -10.
Do not take items like the manual or leaflet without a stated purpose; they cost moves and added no score.

episodes.historian_review: Strongest decisions, all backed by recorded score events: Kitchen +10, Cellar +25, 'take art' +4, 'put painting in case' +6, 'take egg' +5 and 'put egg in case' +5. The Actor moved competently once a route was known. Evidence note: the supplied summary's 29-point total and its jump death don't match the log. The log shows 45 points, and death came from moving north from East Chasm in darkness after 'throw water at lantern' smashed the lamp (-10). Ineffective: roughly 200 steps of Cellar/East Chasm/Gallery/Studio shuttling driven by a stale, never-reached 'take bar' goal, plus bottle, lunch, pepper and manual fiddling that scored 0. Next episode: with art in hand, go Gallery, north to Studio, UP to Kitchen, west to the Living Room, then the trophy case. Protect the light, and never move in the dark.

positives: Open the Behind House window, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move.
Take the lantern, open the trap door and go down for the recorded Cellar +25; light the lantern before exploring.
Cellar south to East Chasm, east to Gallery; 'take art' recorded +4 there.
With art in hand: Gallery, north to Studio, UP to Kitchen, west to Living Room, 'put painting in case' (+6 recorded).
At Up a Tree, 'take egg' recorded +5; at the Living Room, 'put egg in case' recorded +5.
Keep the lantern lit and carried underground; check light before every move and stop if it dims or goes out.
Credit only recorded score events; compare the score after every action and ignore planner gain estimates.
When two objectives stall in a row, take one untried exit or head for the Living Room instead of re-walking known rooms.
negatives: Never throw or pour water at the lantern; it smashed, the light went out, and the grue killed the Actor (-10).
Never move while in darkness; a grue devoured the Actor on a north move from East Chasm after the lamp broke.
Ignore the stale 'take bar' Loud Room goal; it was never reached and fed about 200 steps of looping.
Do not shuttle Cellar, East Chasm, Gallery and Studio without a new observation; none of those loops scored.
Do not 'jump' at East Chasm or any edge; an earlier lesson recorded it as lethal, so don't test it.
Avoid the Troll room north of the Cellar; the Actor entered and left alive three times with no gain, and the troll blocks all exits.
Do not open/close the bottle or drop/take lunch, pepper or manual repeatedly; every cycle scored 0 and wasted moves.
Do not set return-route goals through the trap door; it crashes shut behind you. Use Studio UP to Kitchen instead.

Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water
Done.

The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.

episodes.historian_review: Strongest decisions: the Actor took the egg at Up a Tree (+5), opened the window and went west for Kitchen +10, then banked the egg with 'put egg in case' (+5). It also opened the trap door and went down for the recorded Cellar +25. Symbolic navigation handled the return to the Living Room cleanly. The Actor's weak points were its own choices. It went below with no lantern, then moved south in the pitch-black Cellar on a stale 'take bar' goal, and the grue's -10 left the final score at 35. It also wasted three steps on put down/open case/take egg before depositing. It missed the lantern and any further treasure runs. Next episode: carry and light the lantern before descending, never move in darkness, deposit directly, and ignore planner gain estimates for 'take bar'.

positives: Open the Behind House window, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move.
Take the lantern and light it before opening the trap door and going down; Cellar +25 was recorded on 'down'.
Cellar south to East Chasm, east to Gallery; 'take art' recorded +4 there.
With art in hand: Gallery, north to Studio, UP to Kitchen, west to Living Room, then 'put painting in case' (+6 recorded).
At Up a Tree, 'take egg' recorded +5; at the Living Room, 'put egg in case' directly recorded +5.
Check light before every move underground; if the lantern is missing, dim or out, stay put and do not move.
Credit only recorded score events; compare the score after every action and ignore planner gain estimates.
After banking the egg, try one untried exit at a time near Living Room, Kitchen or Attic, only with a lit lantern.
negatives: Never throw things at the lantern; water thrown at it smashed it, the light went out, and a grue killed the Actor.
Never move in darkness: a grue killed the Actor on the first move south from the pitch-black Cellar (-10).
Treat 'take bar' (Loud Room) as stale and unreachable; it fed 150+ steps of looping and a fatal move.
Do not descend the trap door without a lit lantern; it crashes shut behind you and the Cellar is pitch black.
Do not set return-route goals pointing at the trap door; use Studio UP to Kitchen instead.
Do not shuttle Cellar, East Chasm, Gallery and Studio without a new observation; none of those loops scored.
Avoid the north exit from the Cellar to the Troll room; it is dangerous and gave no gain.
Do not put down, open case and take the egg before depositing; use 'put egg in case' directly.

episodes.historian_review: Strongest Actor decisions: taking the egg (+5), banking it with 'put egg in case' (+5), and taking the lantern and sword before the trap door. 'Down' recorded +25, and the lantern was lit on arrival. 'Take art' recorded +4. The Kitchen +10 came on a symbolic-navigation move after the Actor opened the window. Missed: it descended before lighting the lantern despite the pitch-black warning; it survived, but that was risky. Ineffective: stale 'take bar' goals drove Cellar/East Chasm/Troll shuttling, and the painting was never banked. The final north from East Chasm recorded -10 (final 39, not 35); the truncated text doesn't confirm a grue. Advice: light the lantern before descending, follow a known route with the painting, and ignore stale goals.

positives: Open the Behind House window, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move.
Take the lantern first, open the trap door, and light the lantern before moving anywhere underground; 'down' recorded Cellar +25.
At Up a Tree, 'take egg' recorded +5; at the Living Room, 'put egg in case' directly recorded +5.
Cellar south to East Chasm, east to Gallery; 'take art' recorded +4 there.
After 'take art', head straight back with the painting via Studio UP to Kitchen, then west to bank it.
Check inventory and light status before every underground move; if the lantern is off, turn it on first.
Credit only recorded score events; compare the score after each action and ignore planner gain estimates.
After banking treasure, try one untried exit at a time, carrying a lit lantern.
negatives: Do not descend the trap door with an unlit lantern; the Cellar is pitch black, the door shuts behind you, and a grue threatens.
Never move in darkness; an earlier grue death followed a move out of the pitch-black Cellar (-10).
Treat 'take bar' as stale and unreachable; it fed repeated looping goals this run and was never attempted.
Do not shuttle Cellar, East Chasm, Gallery and Studio without a new observation; none of those loops scored.
Do not retreat south from Studio holding the painting; the Studio UP route to Kitchen is the recorded way home.
Avoid the north exit from the Cellar to the Troll room; it gave no gain.
Do not end a run with the painting unbanked; a +4 treasure scores nothing in hand.
Never throw water or other items at the lantern; an earlier smashed lantern led to darkness and death.

score_events.observation: Taken.

Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
