episodes.historian_review: Note: the briefing's 'this run' summary (lantern, banked egg, art, final 39) conflicts with the recorded evidence, so I follow the evidence. Confirmed: egg +5, Kitchen +10, Cellar +25, then a -10 grue death in the Cellar, ending at 30. The strongest decisions were taking the egg, opening the window and going west, and the rug/trap-door/down sequence. The Actor was weak in three ways. It spent about 25 steps looping Forest, Clearing and Tree after symbolic navigation stalled. It put the egg through the grating, which lost it from inventory. It descended with no lantern and moved north in pitch black, which ended the run. Nothing was banked. Goals for 'take bar'/Loud Room were stale and unreachable. Next time: light the lantern, carry treasure home, and test Studio UP as an unverified return.

positives: At Behind House, 'open window' then 'west' recorded Kitchen +10; do this directly instead of wandering the forest.
'take egg' at Up a Tree recorded +5; keep the treasure in inventory and carry it straight toward the Living Room case.
In the Living Room, push rug, open trap door, then 'down' recorded Cellar +25; light source first.
Take the lantern and light it before any descent; the trap door shuts behind you and the Cellar is pitch black.
Credit only recorded score events; compare the score after each action and ignore planner gain estimates.
Prefer 'carry treasure home' over repeated exploit goals; bank treasure in the trophy case before exploring further.
If a room is revisited three times with no new observation, switch to an untried action or a known route instead of cycling.
From the Studio, test UP as the way home (unverified) before trying the Cellar, since the trap door does not reopen.
negatives: Never move while in pitch darkness; 'north' from the dark Cellar caused the grue death (-10) and ended the run.
Do not descend the trap door without a lit lantern; the door crashes shut behind you and there is no light.
Treat 'take bar' and Loud Room goals as stale and unreachable; they pulled the Actor north into the dark.
Do not put treasure into the grating or drop it; the egg fell into the darkness below and left inventory.
Do not loop Forest Path, Clearing, Forest and Up a Tree; about 25 steps produced no score while the window route stayed unused.
Do not retreat through the Cellar while carrying treasure, or shuttle Cellar/East Chasm; those loops never scored.
Do not end an episode with treasure unbanked; the art (+4) and the egg count for nothing outside the case.
Avoid the Cellar's north exit to the Troll room; it recorded no gain.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

Cellar
You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading north, and a crawlway to the south. On the west is the bottom of a steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
Taken.

episodes.historian_review: The Actor's strongest decisions were 'open window' then 'west' (Kitchen +10 recorded on 'west'), taking and lighting the lantern before descending, and 'take art' in the Gallery (+4). The 'down' step recorded Cellar +25. It spent steps 3-7 shuttling West/North House, but reached the window route soon after. After the trap door shut, it never found a way home. It then cycled Cellar, East Chasm, Gallery and Studio for roughly 35 steps with no score. It also dropped the art, and the planner's stale 'take bar'/Loud Room goal was never reached. The run ended when 'jump' at East Chasm recorded -10 and death, giving a final 29. Next time, keep valuables in inventory, look for untried exits or verbs when stalled, and never use risky verbs. The supplied summary's egg, grue and unlit-descent claims conflict with the trajectory, so I did not use them.

positives: At Behind House, 'open window' then 'west' recorded Kitchen +10. Do this early instead of wandering through North House or the forest.
Take the lantern and turn it on before descending. This run did so, and the Living Room 'down' step recorded Cellar +25.
In the Living Room, push rug, open trap, then 'down' recorded Cellar +25. The door shut behind the Actor, so prepare first.
In the Gallery, 'take art' recorded +4. Pick up portable valuables in new rooms, then keep them in inventory.
Credit only recorded score events. Compare the score after each action and ignore planner gain estimates and historical points-per-attempt figures.
Prefer 'carry treasure home' goals. Keep treasure in inventory and bank it in the Living Room trophy case before exploring further.
After a one-way descent, use 'look' and examine features, then test each untried exit once. Record dead ends so you do not revisit them.
If a room pair repeats three times with no new observation, switch to an untried verb, object or exit instead of cycling.
negatives: Never type 'jump' at East Chasm or any edge or chasm. It recorded -10 and death, ending the run at 29.
Treat 'take bar'/Loud Room as stale. The planner pushed it about 15 times and the Actor never reached it.
Do not shuttle East Chasm, Cellar, Gallery and Studio. About 35 steps there produced no score after the Gallery +4.
Do not put down or drop a carried treasure, as 'put down art' did in the Gallery, while the way home is unknown.
Do not waste opening steps shuttling West House and North House. Steps 3-7 gained nothing before the window route was used.
Do not retry the Cellar's north exit to the Troll room. It recorded no gain and the Actor noted the troll blocks exits.
Do not end with treasure unbanked or without a verified route home. Home return was never verified this run.
When every exit is exhausted, do not choose a random risky action. Try examine, look, inventory or an untried object first.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.

episodes.historian_review: Strongest decisions: after wandering, the Actor opened the Behind House window and entered west, and the log records Kitchen +10. In the Living Room it then pushed the rug, opened the trap door and went 'down', which recorded Cellar +25. Missed opportunities: it took no light source, nothing from the Kitchen, and never checked inventory. It also never banked anything. Ineffective: the mailbox and the North House/Forest Path/Clearing detour cost about six steps with no score. The fatal choice was typing 'south' in the pitch-black Cellar, justified only as 'the only viable option'. That recorded -10 and a grue death, so the final score was 25. The planner's stale 'take bar' goal pulled it onward. Navigation moves were all confirmed; the failure was in action choice. Next time: confirm light and inventory before 'down', and use 'look' or 'inventory' before moving in darkness.

positives: At Behind House, 'open window' then 'west' recorded Kitchen +10. Do this early rather than wandering the North House or forest.
In the Living Room, push rug, open trap, then 'down' recorded Cellar +25. The trap door then shut and was barred behind us.
Before 'down', check inventory for a working light source. If you have none, find one first, because the Cellar was pitch black.
Credit only recorded score changes. Compare the score after each action and ignore planner gain estimates and points-per-attempt figures.
Bank treasure in the Living Room trophy case before descending, and take portable valuables when seen. An earlier run recorded 'take art' +4.
After a one-way descent, run 'look' and 'inventory' first. Then test each untried exit once and record dead ends.
If a room pair repeats three times with no new observation, switch to an untried verb, object or exit.
Treat planner goals as candidates. Check the current observation and prerequisites before following one, and drop goals that are stale or unreachable.
negatives: Never type 'jump' at East Chasm or any edge. An earlier run recorded -10 and death.
Never move blindly in pitch darkness. 'south' from the unlit Cellar recorded a grue death, -10, and ended this run at 25.
Do not pursue 'take bar'/Loud Room. It was a stale planner goal and unreachable in practice. Treat it as unavailable.
Do not descend without a light source, a banked treasure, or a verified route home. This run's home return was never verified.
Do not shuttle East Chasm, Cellar, Gallery and Studio. An earlier run spent about 35-45 steps there with no score after the +4.
Do not waste opening steps on the mailbox and the North House/Forest Path/Clearing loop. Steps 1-6 gained nothing.
Do not drop or put down a carried treasure while the way home is unknown.
When exits look exhausted, do not assume one is 'the only viable option'. Try look, inventory, examine or an untried object first.

episodes.historian_review: The Actor's strongest stretch was steps 11-16: 'open window', 'west' (Kitchen +10), 'push rug', 'open trap', then 'down' (Cellar +25). The Cellar +25 is recorded on the 'down' action. The opening was weak: steps 1-10 went to the mailbox, North House shuttling and a forest loop, with no score. It never ran 'inventory' or 'look' and never took anything useful, so it descended with no light and no way back, since the trap door barred shut. The final action, 'north' in the pitch-black Cellar, ended in a grue death. The Actor's note even called the room dark and dangerous. The trajectory records 17 steps and 'north' as the fatal move, not 13 and 'south'. The planner's stale 'take bar'/'down'/'take egg' goals pushed the Actor, but it still chose to move blind. Next time: check inventory, find and light a light source before 'down', and never move in the dark.

positives: At Behind House, 'open window' then 'west' recorded Kitchen +10. Do this first instead of wandering the North House or forest.
Living Room sequence 'push rug', 'open trap', 'down' recorded Cellar +25. The trap door then shut and was barred behind us.
Before 'down', run 'inventory' and confirm a light source is carried and lit. If none, search the house with 'look' and 'examine' first.
Credit only recorded score changes. Compare the score after each action and ignore planner gain estimates and points-per-attempt figures.
Bank treasures in the Living Room trophy case before descending, and take portable valuables when seen. An earlier run recorded 'take art' +4.
After a one-way descent, run 'look' and 'inventory' first. If the room is lit, test each untried exit once and record dead ends.
If a room pair repeats three times with no new observation, switch to an untried verb, object or exit.
Treat planner goals as candidates. Check the current observation and prerequisites first, and drop goals that are stale or unreachable.
negatives: Never move in pitch darkness. 'north' from the unlit Cellar recorded a grue death (-10) and ended the run at 25.
Never type 'jump' at East Chasm or any edge. An earlier run recorded -10 and death.
Do not descend with no lit light source or verified route home. This run descended unlit and the trap door barred behind us.
Do not pursue 'take bar' or any Loud Room goal. It is unreachable until a lit route there is verified.
Do not follow 'take egg' or 'down' goals blindly. Check the prerequisites and the current room first, because they were repeated without checks.
Do not waste opening steps on the mailbox, North House, Forest Path and Clearing loops. Steps 1-10 gained nothing.
Do not drop or put down a carried treasure while the way home is unknown.
Do not shuttle among East Chasm, Cellar, Gallery and Studio. An earlier run spent about 35-45 steps there with no score after +4.

episodes.historian_review:
The Actor's best sequence was 'open window' then 'west', which recorded Kitchen +10. Later 'turn on lantern', 'push rug', 'open trap' and 'down' recorded Cellar +25. That was prerequisite-ordered, and the lantern was reported on before descending. This contradicts the briefing's claim that it was never lit. The lantern's source was never recorded.

Steps 1-8 produced no score: mailbox, leaflet, and a North House/West House shuttle. The Actor also followed stale 'down', 'take egg' and Loud Room goals. Arriving in the Cellar, which was still reported as 'pitch black', it dropped the leaflet and then moved 'south'. The trajectory records that move as the grue death (-10, final 25); the briefing says 'north'. Navigation transitions were confirmed, so the errors were Actor choices. Next time, run 'look' and 'inventory' after descending, and do not move while the room is dark.

positives: At Behind House, 'open window' then 'west' recorded Kitchen +10. Do this early instead of wandering the mailbox, North House or forest.
Living Room 'push rug', 'open trap', 'down' recorded Cellar +25. The trap door then shut and was barred behind us.
'turn on lantern' succeeded in the Living Room before the descent. Light the lantern, and confirm the light source with 'inventory', before any trap door descent.
After any one-way descent, run 'look' and 'inventory' before moving. If the room says pitch black, do not use any exit.
Credit only recorded score changes. Compare the score after each action and ignore planner gain estimates and points-per-attempt figures.
Treat planner goals as candidates. Check the current room, inventory and prerequisites first, and drop goals that are stale or unreachable.
If a room pair repeats three times with no new observation, switch to an untried verb, object or exit.
Take portable valuables when seen and bank them in the Living Room trophy case before risky descents. An earlier run recorded 'take art' +4.
negatives: Never move in pitch darkness. 'south' from the dark Cellar recorded a grue death (-10) and ended the run at 25.
Never type 'jump' at East Chasm or any edge. An earlier run recorded -10 and death.
Do not assume a lit lantern means light. The Cellar still read 'pitch black' after 'turn on lantern', so verify with 'look' before acting.
Do not pursue 'take bar' or any Loud Room goal. It is unreachable until a lit route there is verified.
Do not follow 'take egg' or 'down' goals blindly. Check the prerequisites and the current room first, because they were repeated without checks.
Do not spend opening steps on the mailbox, leaflet, or North House/West House shuttle. Steps 1-8 gained nothing.
Do not waste turns on item management in the dark, such as dropping the leaflet. Use that turn for 'look' or 'inventory'.
Do not shuttle among East Chasm, Cellar, Gallery and Studio. An earlier run spent about 35-45 steps there with no score after +4.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

Cellar
You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading north, and a crawlway to the south. On the west is the bottom of a steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

episodes.historian_review:
Strongest decisions: 'open window' then 'west' recorded Kitchen +10. The Actor then took the lantern, pushed the rug, turned the lantern on, opened the trap door and went 'down', which recorded Cellar +25. The Cellar description was visible, so the lantern worked this time. The supplied summary blaming darkness and a grue does not match this trajectory. Here the final 'north' into the Troll Room ended with the troll's axe knocking the Actor out (-10, ending at 25 over 24 steps).

Ineffective behavior: the mailbox, leaflet and North House detour cost about four steps with no score. The Actor then shuttled Cellar and Troll Room four times, even after noting that the troll blocked every exit. It also dropped and took the leaflet while under attack. It never ran 'inventory' or 'look', and never tried the unexplored south crawlway. Advice: verify prerequisites, treat a blocked hostile room as a no-go, and try untested exits. Stale 'take egg' and 'take bar' goals pushed the Actor into repetition.

positives: At Behind House, 'open window' then 'west' recorded Kitchen +10. Do this early instead of wandering the mailbox, North House or forest.
In the Living Room, 'take lantern', 'push rug', 'turn on lantern', 'open trap', 'down' recorded Cellar +25 and a visible room description.
Before any descent, take the lantern, run 'inventory' to confirm it is carried and lit, and only then go down.
After any one-way descent, run 'look' and 'inventory' before moving. If the room is pitch black, use no exit; dark rooms are lethal.
Credit only recorded score changes. Compare the score after each action and ignore planner gain estimates and per-attempt point figures.
Treat planner goals as candidates. Check room, inventory and prerequisites first, and drop stale ones such as 'take egg', 'take bar' or repeated 'down'.
After seeing a hostile blocker in a room, leave once and try untried exits such as the Cellar's south crawlway, rather than re-entering.
If a room pair repeats twice with no new observation or score, switch to an untried verb, object or exit.
negatives: Never move in pitch darkness. An earlier run's 'south' from the dark Cellar recorded a grue death (-10).
Do not re-enter the Troll Room once the troll is seen blocking it. Four entries ended in a knockout death (-10) with no score.
Never type 'jump' at East Chasm or any edge. An earlier run recorded -10 and death.
Do not pursue 'take bar', 'take egg' or Loud Room goals without a verified route and prerequisites. They drove the Cellar-Troll shuttle with no gain.
Do not spend opening steps on the mailbox, leaflet or North House/West House. Steps 1-4 gained nothing.
Do not drop or take items with a hostile in the room. The leaflet drop and take drew axe hits and gained nothing.
Do not assume the lantern is carried or lit. An earlier run turned it on without taking it, so check 'inventory'.
Do not shuttle between adjacent rooms such as Cellar-Troll or East Chasm-Gallery-Studio. Past loops burned many steps for no score.

episodes.historian_review:
Score rose 0 to 45 (55 before a -10 grue death). The strongest decisions were all recorded: entering the Kitchen (+10), the Cellar descent (+25), 'take art' (+4) with 'put painting in case' (+6), and 'take egg' (+5) with 'put egg in case' (+5). The Actor also carried treasures home to the case, which is what scored.

The rest was poor. After about step 25 it cycled Gallery/Studio and East Chasm/Cellar for hundreds of steps, following a stale 'take bar' goal that the planner reissued roughly 15 times. Navigation itself was clean (transitions confirmed), so the waste came from Actor choices and goals. It dropped and took junk (manual, lunch, pepper), burned lantern light, and died in the dark at East Chasm (-10). Next episode: check inventory and lantern, deposit treasures, abandon stalled goals after two failures, and return to the surface and untried outdoor areas before light runs low.

positives: At Behind House, 'open window' then 'west' recorded Kitchen +10. Do this early, before any side exploration.
In the Living Room, take lantern, push rug, light lantern, open trap, 'down' recorded Cellar +25. Check 'inventory' for a lit lantern first.
Treasures scored only when deposited: 'take art' +4 then 'put painting in case' +6. Carry finds to the Living Room case and verify the score.
Outdoor exploration scored: 'take egg' at Up a Tree gave +5 and 'put egg in case' +5. Explore surface frontiers when underground stalls.
Credit only recorded score changes. Compare the score after each action and ignore planner gain estimates and per-attempt point figures.
When the lantern warns it is dim or nearly out, stop underground wandering and head back to a lit area at once.
Treat planner goals as candidates. Check room, inventory and prerequisites, and drop a goal after two failed attempts.
If a room pair repeats twice with no new observation or score, switch to an untried verb, object, exit or area.
negatives: Never move in pitch darkness. A grue death (-10) at East Chasm followed the lantern nearly running out, and an earlier run died the same way.
Do not chase the stale 'take bar' Loud Room goal. About 300 steps of Gallery-Studio-East Chasm-Cellar cycling gained nothing.
Do not shuttle Gallery<->Studio or East Chasm<->Cellar. Each pair repeated more than 20 times with zero score.
Do not enter the Troll Room unless the sword is carried and confirmed by inventory. The troll was seen blocking it and it is lethal.
Do not spend opening steps on the mailbox, leaflet or North House. They gained nothing in earlier runs.
Do not waste lantern turns on aimless loops. The lantern ran down, which left the Gallery east exit blocked for lack of light.
Do not drop or take junk (manual, lunch, pepper) as 'exploration'. These actions gave no score and no new information.
Do not accept a stalled goal re-issued by the planner. If a goal stalls twice, pick a new frontier instead.

episodes.historian_review: Confirmed score: the early route (Kitchen +10, Cellar +25) and both treasure deposits (painting +4/+6, egg +5/+5) produced all 55 points. Depositing finds in the case and verifying the score was the Actor's strongest play. Nothing scored afterward. Final score was 45, after a -10 death in the Troll room. The record shows a troll killing the Actor while it chose 'wait', not a grue. The lantern was only noted as dimmer. The Actor entered the Troll room about ten times despite noting it blocked all exits. It took and dropped the manual under axe blows. It also shuttled Cellar/East Chasm, Gallery/Studio and Clearing/Forest Path without a score. It accepted the planner's stale 'take bar' goal repeatedly. The Attic was visited briefly, and a grating was revealed in the clearing but never tried. Next episode: leave stalled loops, avoid the Troll room, and test the grating and other untried exits.

positives: At Behind House, 'open window' then 'west' recorded Kitchen +10. Do this first, before any side exploration.
Take lantern, push rug, light lantern, open trap, then 'down' recorded Cellar +25. Confirm a lit lantern in inventory before descending.
Treasures scored on pickup and again on deposit: painting +4/+6, egg +5/+5. Carry finds to the Living Room case and verify the score.
Studio 'up' led straight to the Kitchen, a confirmed shortcut home from the Gallery. Use it instead of backtracking through the Cellar.
Credit only observed score changes. Ignore planner point estimates such as the 'take bar' +20 and judge each action by the score after it.
Exploring objects can reveal exits: 'take leaves' exposed a grating in a clearing. Test that grating and other untried exits first.
Check lantern fuel when it warns of dimness, and return to the lit surface before it fails.
After two failed attempts at a goal, or one room pair repeating without a score, switch to an untried exit, object or area.
negatives: Never linger in the Troll room. 'wait' there recorded a -10 death. After the first axe hit, leave south at once and do not return.
Do not enter the Troll room without a sword confirmed in inventory. Repeated visits gained nothing and cost health until death.
Do not follow the stale 'take bar' Loud Room goal. About 300 steps chasing it scored zero and no route was verified.
Do not shuttle Cellar<->East Chasm, Gallery<->Studio or Clearing<->Forest Path. Each pair repeated many times with zero score or new information.
Do not take or drop junk (manual, leaves) as exploration, especially in danger. It wasted turns and invited axe hits.
Do not wait or idle in a room where the last observation showed combat. Move away or change approach.
Do not spend opening steps on the mailbox, leaflet or North House. They gave no score in this or earlier runs.
Do not burn lantern turns on aimless loops. Walk with a purpose to an unexplored frontier or the trophy case.

episodes.historian_review: Strongest decisions: the Actor opened the window and went west (Kitchen +10), took the lantern, pushed the rug, opened the trap door and went down (Cellar +25), lit the lantern, and took the Gallery painting (+4). It also left the Troll room south after one visit. Every navigation transition was confirmed, so the failures were the Actor's own choices. It dropped the painting twice in the Gallery and never carried it home. It also shuttled Cellar, East Chasm and Gallery roughly 40 moves, each visited three or more times, chasing a stale 'take bar' goal with no verified route. It never checked inventory for a sword, skipped the Kitchen sack, bottle and Attic, and spent early turns on the mailbox and North House. The run ended with 'jump' at East Chasm, a -10 death. Next episode: keep the painting, deposit it, explore a new frontier, and leave any room on its third visit.

positives: At Behind House, 'open window' then 'west' recorded Kitchen +10 again. Do this first, before any side exploration.
Take lantern, push rug, open trap, 'down' recorded Cellar +25. Light the lantern on arrival and confirm it is lit.
Gallery 'take art' recorded +4. Keep it, carry it to the Living Room trophy case, and verify the deposit score.
Judge actions only by the observed score afterwards. Ignore planner estimates such as +800, +45 or the 'take bar' +20.
Retreating south from the Troll room after one visit avoided harm. Leave at once when a hostile appears, then change plan.
Check inventory for sword and lantern before entering any danger room, and confirm the lantern is lit before dark areas.
When a goal stalls, test an untried exit or object: Kitchen sack and bottle, Attic stairs, the grating found by taking leaves.
After a room is visited three times, or a room pair repeats without score, leave and choose an unvisited frontier.
negatives: Never 'jump' at East Chasm or similar edges. It recorded a -10 death. Do not use risky verbs as a last-resort exploration move.
Do not 'put down' a scored treasure away from the trophy case. The painting was dropped twice in the Gallery and left behind.
Do not shuttle Cellar<->East Chasm or East Chasm<->Gallery. About 40 moves produced zero score and no new information.
Do not pursue the stale 'take bar' Loud Room goal. No route was verified and repeated attempts only produced cycling.
Do not enter the Troll room without a sword confirmed in inventory, and never wait there. An earlier run died doing so.
Do not spend opening steps on the mailbox, leaflet or North House. They scored nothing in this or earlier runs.
Do not stay underground looping while the Kitchen sack, bottle and Attic go unexamined. Unexplored objects beat repeated rooms.
Do not burn lantern turns on aimless loops. Walk purposefully to an unexplored frontier or the trophy case.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.

episodes.historian_review:
The Actor's strongest play was early. 'open window' then 'west' recorded Kitchen +10. 'take lantern', 'push rug', 'open trap' and 'down' recorded Cellar +25, and it lit the lantern on arrival. Its replies were sensible as written, but the stale planner goals pushed it toward the Troll room.

It missed the Kitchen sack and bottle and never took or checked for a sword. Mailbox and North House cost three zero-score steps. The worst behavior was entering the Troll room five times from the Cellar. Its own note said 'troll blocks all exits', yet it went north again, was knocked out, and the -10 ended the episode. The Cellar and Troll room were each visited several times for zero score. Next time, confirm the sword in inventory first, then try one new frontier such as the Kitchen items.

positives: At Behind House, 'open window' then 'west' recorded Kitchen +10. Do this first, before any side exploration.
'take lantern', 'push rug', 'open trap', 'down' recorded Cellar +25. Turn the lantern on at arrival and confirm it is lit.
Before descending, check inventory for lantern and sword. Take any visible sword first, and treat any treasure as keep-only.
Judge actions only by observed score changes. Ignore planner estimates such as +825, +45 or +20.
Examine the Kitchen sack and bottle seen on the table. Known objects are a better frontier than rooms already visited.
Choose ONE new frontier per goal. Leave any room visited twice, such as Cellar or Troll, and do not return.
Leaving the Troll room on first sight avoided harm. Stay out until inventory shows a sword.
Once you hold a treasure, keep it. A prior 'take art' recorded +4. Deposit it only along an observed route.
negatives: Do not enter the Troll room without a sword in inventory. Five entries ended in a -10 knockout and the episode ended.
Do not shuttle Cellar<->Troll. About ten moves gave zero score and no new information. Leave after the second visit.
Do not follow replayed historical goals (bar, egg) that have no verified route. They produced only cycling.
Do not use risky verbs such as 'jump' at edges. An earlier run recorded -10 death that way.
Do not drop a scored treasure away from a verified deposit spot. The painting was dropped twice in the Gallery earlier.
Do not spend opening steps on the mailbox, leaflet or North House. They scored nothing again.
Do not repeat a move after your own note says it is hostile or blocked. 'Troll blocks all exits' preceded another 'north'.
Do not plan on returning home underground. The trap door barred shut behind the descent, and no return route is observed.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

Cellar
You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading north, and a crawlway to the south. On the west is the bottom of a steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
Taken.

episodes.historian_review: Strongest decisions came early: 'west' from Behind House recorded Kitchen +10, 'down' from the Living Room recorded +25 on entering the Cellar, and 'take art' in the Gallery recorded +4. Final score was 29. After that, the Actor stalled for hundreds of steps. It cycled Cellar, East Chasm, Gallery and Studio, entered Troll four times and retreated each time, and chased the stale 'take bar' and 'take egg' goals with no verified route. Nothing in the evidence shows an inventory check before the Troll entries. The lantern was apparently failing ('more light than from the brass lantern'), yet the Actor waited, closed and opened the bottle, then went 'north' in the dark and a grue killed it (-10). The planner's repeated stale goals made things worse, but the Actor's cycling and dark-room risk were its own. Next time: check inventory and light first, and use a different exit from any room already entered twice.

positives: At Behind House, 'open window' then 'west' recorded Kitchen +10. Do this first, before any side exploration.
In the Living Room, take sword and lantern, check 'inventory', then 'down'. That 'down' recorded Cellar +25.
'take art' in the Gallery recorded +4. Keep any scored treasure in inventory and do not drop it away from a verified deposit spot.
Turn the lantern on at Cellar arrival and confirm it is lit. Re-check light before any exit into an unlit room.
Retreating 'south' from the Troll room each time avoided harm. Stay out until inventory confirms a sword.
Set one new frontier per goal. After a second entry into any room, take a different exit instead of the one just used.
Trust only recorded score events. Ignore historical +20 or +45 estimates that lack a verified route from your current room.
When text warns about light, fix it first: check the lantern, or return to a lit room. Never push on.
negatives: Do not move into a dark room. 'north' from East Chasm with a failing lantern ended in a grue death (-10).
Do not shuttle Cellar<->East Chasm or Gallery<->Studio. Dozens of moves there gave zero score. Pick an unvisited exit after the second visit.
Do not follow replayed 'take bar' or 'take egg' goals. They have no verified route and produced only cycling.
Do not enter the Troll room without 'inventory' showing a sword. It was entered four times with no check.
Do not 'wait' or toggle the bottle while lost in the dark. Those actions cost steps and fixed nothing about the light.
Do not give items to the thief or shuffle the manual and bottle. Those actions scored nothing.
Never use 'jump' or other risky verbs at edges or in dark places. An earlier run recorded a death that way.
Do not spend more than a few steps without new information. Over 300 steps after the +4 gained nothing; try a fresh frontier early.

episodes.historian_review: Strongest decisions: the early sequence recorded Kitchen +10, Cellar +25, Gallery 'take art' +4, and 'put painting in case' +6 at the Living Room (peak 45). Retreating south from the Troll room avoided harm. Missed opportunities: after the deposit, most of the 253 steps scored nothing, and the Actor never committed to a truly unexplored exit. Ineffective: Cellar, East Chasm, Gallery, Studio and Troll were each entered many times. Replayed 'take bar'/'take egg' goals had no verified route and fed the cycling. 'Give thief water', 'open bottle' and dropping the manual scored nothing. 'Hit troll with knife' only pinked the troll. The lantern was noted dim late, yet movement continued; the final 'south' from Cellar recorded -10 (end 35). Navigation transitions executed reliably, so the failure was goal choice. Next: one unexplored exit per goal, check the lantern first, never move in the dark.

positives: Open the window at Behind House, then go west: Kitchen +10 was recorded. Repeat this opening before any side exploration.
In the Living Room, take sword and lantern, check 'inventory', then go down. That 'down' recorded Cellar +25.
'take art' in the Gallery recorded +4, and 'put painting in case' at the Living Room recorded +6. Carry scored items straight home.
Check that the lantern is lit on arriving underground. If the text says dim, return to a lit room before any further move.
Retreating south from the Troll room each time avoided harm. Re-enter only with a sword confirmed by 'inventory', and attack once.
Set one unexplored exit per goal. After a room's second entry, take a different exit than the one just used.
Trust only recorded score events. Ignore historical 'gain' estimates that lack a verified route from your current room.
When the text warns about light, fix that first by checking the lantern or going to a lit room. Never push on.
negatives: Do not move while the lantern is dim or the room is dark. The run ended with a -10 move out of the Cellar.
Do not shuttle Cellar<->East Chasm, Gallery<->Studio or Cellar<->Troll. Dozens of moves there scored 0. Pick an unvisited exit after the second visit.
Do not follow replayed 'take bar' or 'take egg' goals. No route was ever verified, and they drove most of the cycling.
Do not enter the Troll room without 'inventory' showing a sword. A knife attack only pinked the troll, so do not repeat it.
Do not 'open bottle', drop the manual, or give items to the thief. Those actions scored nothing and cost steps.
Do not hand items to the thief or interact with him near the Cellar. 'Give thief water' changed nothing, and the last room showed a hostile bag-carrier.
Do not keep issuing moves after 20 steps with no new score or new room. Switch to an untried exit immediately.
Do not leave the Living Room area with a scored treasure still in hand. Deposit it first, then explore.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

episodes.historian_review: Strongest decisions: opening the window and going west recorded Kitchen +10. Pushing the rug, opening the trap door and going down recorded Cellar +25. Taking the sword was sensible. Missed opportunities: no 'take lantern' or 'inventory' was ever recorded. The Cellar was pitch black, and the Actor moved south in the dark and died to a grue (-10). It is a hypothesis that the lantern was left in the Living Room. The open trophy case was never used. Ineffective behavior: about 25 steps of Kitchen<->Living Room and Attic up/down shuttling (Attic entered 3 times, Kitchen about 10), driven by stale 'take egg' and 'down' goals. Next episode: confirm the lantern is in inventory and lit before descending, never move in darkness, and pick an unvisited exit after a room's second entry.

positives: Open the window at Behind House, then go west: Kitchen +10 was recorded. Repeat this opening before side exploration.
In the Living Room, push the rug, open the trap door, then go down: the 'down' move recorded Cellar +25.
Before descending, take the lantern, run 'inventory', and confirm it is both held and lit. The Cellar arrival text was pitch black.
Take the sword before going underground. The sword glowed faintly blue on Cellar arrival, which is useful hazard feedback worth reading.
If the text says dark or pitch black, handle light first: check inventory, light the lantern, or stop. Never take a blind exit.
After a room's second entry, choose a different, unvisited exit or an unused item action instead of the move just used.
Trust only recorded score events. Treat historical 'gain' estimates for take egg, take bar or down as unverified candidates.
Carry any scored item back to the Living Room and deposit it in the open case, then explore. Check the case state first.
negatives: Never move while the room is pitch black. A 'south' move from the dark Cellar was followed by a grue death (-10).
Do not shuttle Kitchen<->Living Room. About 25 such moves scored 0. After one revisit, use a new exit.
Do not go Kitchen<->Attic repeatedly. The Attic was dark on all 3 entries and each visit scored nothing.
Do not turn on the lantern and then leave it behind. 'turn on lantern' is not 'take lantern'; confirm with 'inventory'.
Do not follow replayed 'take egg' or 'take bar' goals. They never produced points and caused most of the wandering.
Do not descend the trap door without a lit light source in hand. It crashed shut behind the Actor, so there is no retreat.
Do not open the trophy case with nothing to deposit. It cost a step and scored nothing.
Do not keep issuing moves for 20 steps without a new room or new score. Switch to an untried exit or item action.

episodes.historian_review: Strongest decisions: the Actor opened the window, entered the Kitchen (+10 recorded), then pushed the rug, opened the trap door and went down (+25 recorded). That was 9 efficient steps. It also ignored the stale 'take egg' goals and acted on what the room text showed. No room was entered twice and there was no back-and-forth. Ineffective: it descended with only a leaflet and no light source. In the pitch-black Cellar it moved 'north' anyway, reasoning that it was the only direction. The log shows this move ended in a grue death (-10). The brief mentioned 'south', but the log records 'north'. Missed: it never checked inventory, never looked for a light, and never read the leaflet. Next episode: reuse the opening, secure light before going down, and if dark, light it and do not move. Separately, the symbolic goals were stale, though the Actor mostly overrode them.

positives: Open the window at Behind House, then go west: Kitchen +10 was recorded. Repeat this opening before side exploration.
In the Living Room, push the rug, open the trap door, then go down: that 'down' move recorded Cellar +25.
Before descending, run 'inventory' and confirm a light source is held and lit. The Cellar arrival text was pitch black.
If text says dark or pitch black, handle light first: check inventory, light the lantern if held, otherwise do not move.
Read room text and prefer visible, state-matching actions over stale historical goals; the Actor's window, rug and trap-door steps scored.
After a second entry to any room, pick an unvisited exit or an unused item action instead of the move just used.
Trust only recorded score events. Treat historical gain estimates for take egg, take bar or down as unverified candidates.
Look for a portable light source and any weapon in the house before going underground, and check inventory after taking them.
negatives: Never move while the room is pitch black. A move from the dark Cellar (logged as 'north') led to a grue death (-10).
Do not descend the trap door without a lit light source. It crashed shut behind the Actor, so there is no retreat.
Do not reason that a dark exit is the only direction to explore. Dark means light first, or stay put.
Do not shuttle Kitchen<->Living Room. A prior episode lost about 25 moves to it with 0 score. Use a new exit after one revisit.
Do not go Kitchen<->Attic repeatedly. The Attic was dark on all 3 prior entries and every visit scored nothing.
Do not follow replayed 'take egg' or 'take bar' goals. They never produced points in recorded events and caused wandering.
Do not leave the leaflet or other starting items unread and unused without a reason; check for hints before risky descents.
Do not make exploratory detours like North House when the score route is known, unless the exits are untried and safe.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.

episodes.historian_review: Strongest decisions: opening the window then going west (Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move), and the push rug, open trap door, down sequence (Cellar +25 recorded on 'down'). Taking the leaflet and lighting the lantern were sensible. Missed opportunities: it never ran inventory or read the leaflet, and it detoured through North House. Kitchen and Living Room were each entered twice, costing about 3 moves for no score. Ineffective: the final move out of the pitch-black Cellar ended the episode with -10. The log shows 'south', though the briefing says north. The lantern was reported on in the Living Room, yet the Cellar was still pitch black; the cause is unverified because inventory was never checked. Stale egg/bar goals came from symbolic navigation, not the Actor. Next episode: if dark, do not move; check inventory and light the lantern. Goal: get and light the lantern; do not move.

positives: Open the window at Behind House, then go west: Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move. Repeat this opening before side exploration.
In the Living Room, push the rug, open the trap door, then go down: that 'down' move recorded Cellar +25.
Before descending, run 'inventory' and confirm a light source is held and lit. The Cellar arrival text was pitch black.
If text says dark or pitch black, stop and fix light first: check inventory, take or light the lantern, and do not move.
Prefer visible, state-matching actions over stale historical goals; the window, rug and trap-door steps all matched the room text.
On a second entry to any room, pick an unvisited exit or an unused item action instead of the move just used.
Trust only recorded score events. Treat historical gain estimates for take egg, take bar or down as unverified candidates.
Take the lantern from the Living Room before descending, then check inventory to verify it is carried and lit.
negatives: Never move while the room is pitch black. Leaving the dark Cellar (logged 'south') ended the game with a -10 grue death.
Do not descend the trap door without confirming a lit light source. It crashes shut behind you, so there is no retreat.
Do not treat a dark exit as the only direction to explore. Dark means light first, or stay put.
Do not shuttle Kitchen<->Living Room. Both rooms were entered twice this episode with no score. Use a new exit after one revisit.
Do not trust a 'lantern is on' message alone. The Cellar was still pitch black, so verify with inventory and look before moving.
Do not follow replayed 'take egg' or 'take bar' goals. They pointed at unreachable places and never produced recorded points.
Do not leave the leaflet unread. Read it and check inventory before a risky descent.
Do not make exploratory detours such as North House when the scoring route is known, unless the exits are untried and safe.

Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.

episodes.historian_review: The Actor's strongest play was the opening. It opened the window and moved west, where Kitchen +10 was recorded. It then took the lantern ("Taken."), pushed the rug and opened the trap door. The 'down' move recorded Cellar +25, and it lit the lantern on arrival. The evidence contradicts the claim that the lantern was never taken or that death came from moving south in the dark. Death followed the fourth entry into the Troll room, where the troll knocked the Actor out (-10 at the terminal step). The Actor shuttled Cellar/Troll/East Chasm (Cellar 5+ entries, Troll 4, East Chasm 2) and never ran inventory or read the leaflet. It also kept obeying stale egg/bar goals. Next goal: confirm the lantern is carried and lit, avoid the Troll room, and try one untried Cellar exit.

positives: Open the window at Behind House, then go west: Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move. Repeat this opening before side exploration.
In the Living Room, take the lantern, push the rug, open the trap door, then go down: 'down' recorded Cellar +25.
Before descending, run 'inventory' and confirm the lantern is carried; after arriving in darkness, turn it on immediately, as done this episode.
If text says dark or pitch black, do not move until the light source is confirmed on, via inventory or look.
Prefer actions that match the room text, such as window, rug and trap door, over stale replayed goals.
On re-entering a room, choose an unvisited exit instead of the move just used. Cellar, Troll and East Chasm were all revisited.
Trust only recorded score events: Kitchen +10 and Cellar +25. Treat egg, bar and large 'down' gain estimates as unverified.
When a room's text names a hazard, such as a troll blocking all passages, leave and record it as dangerous.
negatives: Do not re-enter the Troll room. Four visits brought axe hits, and the last one knocked the Actor out with a -10 terminal penalty.
Do not shuttle Cellar<->Troll<->East Chasm. Repeating a move with no score and no new information wasted about ten steps.
Do not follow replayed 'take egg' or 'take bar' goals when their locations are unreachable or unverified. They produced no points.
Do not spend turns on actions like dropping the leaflet while taking damage. Retreat or change approach, since it did not stop the axe hit.
Do not leave the leaflet unread or skip 'inventory' before a risky descent. Neither check was done despite the earlier lessons.
Do not wander the forest for three moves when the Behind House route is already known.
Do not treat 'lantern is on' as proof that exploration is safe. Check room text for hostile creatures before each move.
Do not keep moving after repeated damage or warning text. Stop and reassess exits before trying the same direction again.

Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

episodes.historian_review: Strongest decisions: the Actor opened the window and went west, and Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move. It also took the sword, then pushed the rug, opened the trap door and went down, with Cellar +25 recorded on 'down'. Missed opportunities: it never took the lantern, never ran 'inventory' before descending, and left the leaflet unread. Ineffective behavior: it shuttled Kitchen↔Living Room, entering each four times, while chasing stale egg and bar goals that produced nothing. The fatal error was moving north in a pitch-black Cellar; a grue killed it and the terminal step recorded -10. The evidence shows no Troll Room visit, so the troll-death framing is unsupported. Advice: confirm lantern and sword before descending, and do not move in darkness. Next goal: take the lantern, check inventory, then descend.

positives: Open the window at Behind House, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move. Repeat it before side exploration.
In the Living Room, push the rug, open the trap door, then go down; Cellar +25 was recorded on 'down'.
Take the sword before descending; it was taken this episode, and arriving armed matches the rule never to enter hostile rooms unarmed.
Run 'inventory' before any descent and confirm both lantern and sword are carried. Do not assume an item was picked up.
Trust only recorded score events: Kitchen +10 and Cellar +25. Treat egg, bar and large 'down' gains as unverified.
Choose actions that match the room text, such as window, rug and trap door, over stale replayed goals.
On arriving in a room you have already entered, pick an untried exit instead of reversing the move you just made.
If text says dark or pitch black, stop and use 'inventory' or 'look'; act only to establish light.
negatives: Do not move while the room is pitch black. Moving north in the dark Cellar led to grue death and a -10 penalty.
Do not descend without the lantern. It was never taken this episode, so the Cellar arrival left the Actor with no light.
Do not shuttle Kitchen↔Living Room. Four entries into each room, with no new score or information, wasted about eight moves.
Do not chase replayed 'take egg' or 'take bar' goals when the location is unreachable or unverified; they gave no points.
Do not skip 'inventory' before risky steps. The check was skipped again despite earlier lessons.
Do not leave the leaflet unread after taking it; its text may carry useful information.
Do not treat the trap door crashing shut as a cue to explore; stop and assess light and exits first.
Do not enter the Troll Room unarmed; no visit is recorded here, but carry the sword and check room text before any move.

Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Taken.

episodes.historian_review:
Confirmed scoring: Kitchen +10 (west from Behind House), Cellar +25 (down), and Gallery 'take art' +4. The final 'give troll manual' cost -10 and ended the episode. The supplied death note (grue) conflicts with this trajectory, which shows the troll death, so I trust the trajectory.

Strongest decisions were the early scoring route and taking the art. Both were verified by score events. Symbolic navigation was reliable; every transition was confirmed. The Actor's own choices were the weak part. From about step 70 it shuttled through Cellar, East Chasm, Gallery, Studio and Troll, all entered many times, with no gain after +4. It never banked the painting or verified a route home. It also chased stale 'take bar' and 'take egg' goals and probed with drop/take of the leaflet and manual. Giving an item to a hostile troll was the fatal error. Next episode: carry the painting home, try one untried exit or look/examine before any risky action, and never give items to hostile creatures.

positives: Open the window at Behind House, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move. Repeat it before side exploration.
In the Living Room, push the rug, open the trap door, then go down; Cellar +25 was recorded on 'down'.
'Take art' at the Gallery gave +4. In new rooms, examine objects and take plausible valuables, then check the score line to verify.
Run 'inventory' before descending or entering any hostile room, and confirm both lantern and sword are carried.
In pitch black, light the lantern first and do not move until the room text shows light.
Trust only recorded score events. Ignore replayed 'take bar' and 'take egg' goals that point at unreachable places.
After two visits to the same room pair, pick an untried exit or use look/examine instead of reversing.
Before a room with a hostile occupant, read the text and use look/examine once. Retreat if blocked; never test risky interactions.
negatives: Never 'give' items to the troll. 'give troll manual' led to decapitation and -10, ending the episode.
Do not keep re-entering the Troll room unprepared. Repeated visits gave no score and no new information.
Do not shuttle Cellar, East Chasm, Gallery and Studio. Over 100 moves after +4 produced no new score.
Do not follow replayed 'take bar' or 'take egg' goals; they never produced points here and drove the loops.
Do not move north in the dark Cellar without a lit lantern; a grue risk killed a previous episode.
Do not descend without confirming lantern and sword via 'inventory'. Notes claimed a lantern, but it was never verified.
Do not use drop/take of the leaflet or manual as a probe. It did nothing, and read the leaflet instead.
Do not wander underground with treasure while the route home is unverified. The painting was never banked.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.

episodes.historian_review: The Actor opened the window, entered the Kitchen (+10 recorded on that west move), then pushed the rug, opened the trap door and went down (+25 recorded). That was efficient: 10 moves, 35 points gained. The fatal error was in the dark Cellar. It never checked inventory or the leaflet and descended empty-handed. It then moved south in pitch black although its own note said north, and a grue killed it (-10, final score 25). Navigation goals ('take egg', 'take bar') were stale and mostly ignored, which was sensible. The Actor's weakness was opening decisions and risk handling, not the route. Next episode: repeat the scoring route, but take and check light and weapon before descending. If the room is dark, do not move until light is confirmed. Make the action match the stated plan.

positives: Open the window at Behind House, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move. Repeat it early.
In the Living Room, push the rug, open the trap door, then go down; Cellar +25 was recorded on that move.
Run 'inventory' in the Kitchen or Living Room before descending, and confirm a light source is carried; only then use the trap door.
On arriving in pitch black, the first action must be to light a carried lamp. Make no movement commands until the text shows light.
Take plausible portable objects in the house before going underground; this run went down empty-handed. Verify any score change on the score line.
Trust only recorded score events. Ignore replayed 'take egg' and 'take bar' goals when their locations are unreachable.
Before each move, check that the command matches the stated plan and exits. Avoid contradictions like planning north and sending south.
After two visits to the same room pair, pick an untried exit or use look/examine instead of reversing.
negatives: Never move in a dark room without a lit light source. Moving south in the dark Cellar led to grue death and -10.
Do not descend the trap door empty-handed or without checking inventory. This run reached the Cellar with nothing.
Never 'give' items to the troll. A previous 'give troll manual' ended in decapitation and -10.
Do not follow stale 'take egg' or 'take bar' goals; they previously produced loops and were irrelevant to the actual route here.
Do not shuttle Cellar, East Chasm, Gallery and Studio. Over 100 such moves after +4 earlier gave no new score.
Do not re-enter the Troll room unprepared. Repeat visits gave no score or information; attack only with a wielded weapon.
Do not skip cheap information: open the mailbox but also read the leaflet instead of dropping or taking it as a probe.
Do not wander underground carrying treasure with the route home unverified. The earlier painting was never banked.

episodes.historian_review:
Actor: it took the lantern before descending and its first action in the dark Cellar was 'turn on lantern', avoiding the earlier grue death. The recorded +10 came on the move west into the Kitchen (after opening the window) and the +25 on 'down'. Opening the mailbox was sensible, but the leaflet was never read.

Ineffective: after lighting the lantern it shuttled Cellar↔Troll about five times with no score or new information, and never tried the Kitchen's visible upward staircase. It dropped and retook the leaflet under attack, then 'give troll leaflet' ended the run with -10. The stale 'take egg'/'take bar' goals from the symbolic layer drove that loop, and the Actor should have overridden them. Next time: check inventory for a weapon, attack rather than give, and try an untried exit.

positives: Open the window at Behind House, then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move. Repeat it early.
Take the lantern in the Living Room, push the rug, open the trap door, go down; Cellar +25 was recorded on 'down'.
In pitch black, make 'turn on lantern' the only first action. This run did so and survived the Cellar arrival.
Run 'inventory' before descending and confirm the lantern is carried. This run held only lantern and leaflet, so check for a weapon too.
After taking the leaflet from the mailbox, read it; it is free information and was carried unread this run.
Trust only recorded score events. Override stale 'take egg' and 'take bar' goals when their locations are unreachable or irrelevant.
When blocked or attacked, stop and use look, examine or inventory, then pick a different action instead of repeating the same move.
After two visits to a room pair, take an untried exit, such as the Kitchen's upward staircase, instead of reversing.
negatives: Never 'give' items to the troll. 'give troll manual' and 'give troll leaflet' both ended in death and -10.
Never move in a dark room without a lit light source. Moving south in the dark Cellar caused grue death and -10.
Do not shuttle Cellar and Troll. About five round trips this run gave no score and brought axe hits.
Do not drop and retake items in front of a hostile troll. It wasted turns and cost health without helping.
Do not follow replayed 'take egg' or 'take bar' goals; they produced loops and no observed score this run.
Do not re-enter the Troll room unarmed. Verify a weapon is wielded, and attack instead of offering items.
Do not descend without checking the house for useful gear. Only a lantern and leaflet were carried underground this run.
Do not keep a failing pattern past three visits to the same room. Flag Cellar and Troll as overvisited and change plan.

episodes.historian_review: The Actor's strongest decisions were opening the window and going west, which recorded Kitchen +10. It then took the sword, pushed the rug, opened the trap door and went down, which recorded Cellar +25. Those four Living Room steps were efficient. The failures were the first six moves wandering Forest, Forest Path and Clearings with no score, leaving the leaflet in the mailbox, and descending without any recorded light source or inventory check. Moving south in the pitch-black Cellar ended in grue death (-10). Symbolic goals repeatedly pushed stale 'take egg', 'down' and 'take bar' targets, and the Actor mostly ignored them. Its descent was its own choice, so the death is the Actor's fault. Next episode: go straight to Behind House, take the lantern and leaflet, check inventory, light the lantern on arrival, and try the Kitchen's untried upward staircase.

positives: At Behind House, open the window then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move. Do it first, skipping forest detours.
In the Living Room, take the sword (confirmed 'Taken.'), push the rug, open the trap door, then go down; Cellar +25 was recorded.
Run 'inventory' before descending and confirm a light source is carried; this run descended without any recorded lantern.
Take the lantern from the Living Room before the trap door; the Cellar is pitch black and the door shut behind us.
On pitch-black arrival, make 'turn on lantern' the first action if carried; avoid any movement command until light is confirmed.
Take and read the mailbox leaflet; opening the mailbox revealed it this run, but the Actor left it behind.
Override stale 'take egg', 'take bar' and repeated 'down' goals when they are unreachable or already used; trust only recorded score events.
After two visits to a room, take an untried exit, such as the Kitchen's upward staircase, instead of reversing.
negatives: Never move in a dark room without a lit light source; moving south in the dark Cellar caused grue death and -10.
Never 'give' items to the troll; earlier runs ended in death and -10. Wield the sword and attack instead.
Do not spend the opening moves looping Forest, Forest Path and Clearings; six such moves gave no score.
Do not descend carrying only a sword; check for lantern and other useful gear first.
Do not follow replayed 'take egg' or 'take bar' goals; they produced no observed score and pointed to unreachable places.
Do not shuttle between Cellar and Troll rooms; flag any room visited 3+ times as overvisited and change plan.
Do not enter the Troll room unarmed or without a wielded weapon; do not drop and retake items beside a hostile troll.
Do not open the mailbox and walk away without taking the leaflet; unread items waste free information.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

episodes.historian_review: The Actor opened with a sound sequence: it opened the mailbox and took the leaflet, opened the window, went west (Kitchen +10 recorded on that move), then took the sword, pushed the rug and opened the trap door. Descending was followed by Cellar +25. It skipped forest wandering this run, which is a clear improvement. Its main failures were descending without the lantern, never checking inventory, and moving north in pitch darkness. A grue killed it and the score fell by 10, ending at 25 with the remaining potential unused. The leaflet was taken but never read. Symbolic goals were stale and misleading (take egg, take bar, repeated down); the Actor ignored them reasonably early, but the final north move came while the goal pointed at the unreachable Loud Room. Next time: take the lantern, confirm it with inventory, turn it on first in the Cellar, then wield the sword and face the troll.

positives: At Behind House, open the window then go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move. Do it first, skipping forest detours.
In the Living Room, take the sword, push the rug, open the trap door, then go down; Cellar +25 was recorded on descent.
Take the lantern in the Living Room before opening the trap door; the Cellar is pitch black and the door shuts behind you.
Run 'inventory' before descending and confirm both lantern and sword are carried; the last run descended with the sword only.
On pitch-black arrival, make 'turn on lantern' the very first action; use no movement command until light is confirmed.
Read the leaflet after taking it; it was taken last run but never read, so its information went unused.
Override stale 'take egg', 'take bar' and repeated 'down' goals when unreachable or already used; trust only recorded score events.
After two visits to a room, try an untried exit, such as the Kitchen's staircase, instead of reversing; flag 3+ visits.
negatives: Never move in a dark room without light; moving in the dark Cellar (north last run, south earlier) led to grue death and -10.
Never 'give' items to the troll; earlier runs ended in death and -10. Wield the sword and attack instead.
Do not spend opening moves looping Forest, Forest Path and Clearings; six such moves earlier gave no score.
Do not descend carrying only a sword; check for the lantern first, since descending without light proved fatal.
Do not follow replayed 'take egg' or 'take bar' goals; they produced no observed score this run and pointed to unreachable places.
Do not shuttle between Cellar and Troll rooms; any room visited 3+ times is overvisited, so change plan.
Do not enter the Troll room unarmed or without a wielded weapon; do not drop and retake items beside a hostile troll.
Do not take items like the leaflet and never read them; carrying unread information wastes free hints.

episodes.historian_review: The Actor opened with a sound sequence. It took the lantern and sword, pushed the rug, opened the trap door and descended (Cellar +25 recorded). It turned on the lantern before moving, which fixed last run's fatal mistake. The Gallery art pickup recorded +4, and the +5 recorded on the east move out of the Troll room followed knocking out the troll with the sword. The remaining ~100 moves were largely wasted. The Actor never confirmed a route back to the Living Room, so the painting was never banked. It shuttled between Gallery/Studio, Cellar/East Chasm, Dam Lobby/Maintenance Room and Round Room/North-South Passage, and it pushed the brown button repeatedly while the water rose. It also chased a stale 'take bar' goal with no score. The symbolic goal loop encouraged this, but the Actor never broke it. Next time, switch to unexplored exits after two repeats and read the manual and guidebook.

positives: At Behind House, open the window and go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move. Do this first and skip forest detours.
In the Living Room take lantern and sword, push rug, open trap door, then go down; Cellar +25 was recorded on descent.
On pitch-black Cellar arrival, 'turn on lantern' first and move only after light is confirmed; this run it avoided the grue.
Wield the sword and attack the troll; it was knocked out and the next east move recorded +5. Never hand items over.
Examine and take portable items in newly entered rooms; Gallery 'take art' recorded +4. Check each new room's objects once on first entry.
Read the manual and guidebook right after taking them; both were taken this run but never read, so their hints went unused.
After two failed or repeated moves between the same rooms, try a never-used exit instead of reversing; list untried exits before choosing.
Override stale goals such as 'take egg', 'take bar' and repeated 'down' when unreachable; trust only recorded score events and flag rooms visited 3+ times.
negatives: Never move in a dark room without light; dark movement in the Cellar caused grue deaths and -10 in earlier runs.
Never 'give' items to the troll; earlier runs ended in death and -10. Wield the sword and attack instead.
Do not shuttle between adjacent rooms such as Gallery/Studio or Dam Lobby/Maintenance Room; this run spent ~100 moves cycling for zero score.
Do not push the brown button repeatedly in the Maintenance Room; water rose from knees to neck with no score. Stop once an action only worsens the room.
Do not run the 'return to Living Room' goal for dozens of steps once the route is unknown; the trap door is barred, so explore fresh exits.
Do not chase the stale 'take bar' goal into the Loud Room again; repeated visits produced no pickup or score this run.
Do not descend without both lantern and sword; check inventory before 'down' because the trap door bars behind you.
Do not collect tools like wrench, matchbook and tube without a plan or a recorded score effect; none produced points this run.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

East-West Passage
This is a narrow east-west passageway. There is a narrow stairway leading down at the north end of the room.
Taken.

episodes.historian_review:
Score rose from 0 to 40 (+50 earned, -10 for drowning). Confirmed score events were Kitchen +10 (west from Behind House after opening the window), Cellar +25 (down), +5 on the first east move after the troll died, and +10 for 'take bar' in the Loud Room. Strong Actor decisions: it took both lantern and sword before descending, turned the lantern on before moving, and killed the troll with the sword.

Ineffective behavior: about 12 opening moves looping between the houses, four visits to the Loud Room, and a long Dam Lobby/Maintenance Room shuttle. The Actor also pushed the buttons, and the blue button's leak flooded the room. It kept re-entering as the water rose and drowned (-10). The symbolic goals (stale 'take egg', 'down', 'take bar') pushed it around, but the fatal choices were the Actor's. Next time: leave a worsening room for good and try untried exits.

positives: At Behind House, open the window and go west; Kitchen +10 was recorded on that move. Do this first and skip house-perimeter loops.
In the Living Room take lantern and sword before push rug, open trap, down; Cellar +25 was recorded with both in hand.
On pitch-black arrival, 'turn on lantern' before any move; this run it avoided the grue. Confirm light first.
Wield the sword and attack the troll; it died and the next east move recorded +5. Never hand items over.
Check each new room's objects on first entry; Loud Room 'take bar' recorded +10. Take what is visible, then move on.
Before reversing between two rooms, list untried exits and pick one; the Dam Lobby/Maintenance Room shuttle scored nothing.
Treat warnings like rising water as stop signals: leave the room immediately and do not re-enter.
Override stale goals ('take egg', 'take bar', repeated 'down'); trust only recorded score events and flag rooms visited 3+ times.
negatives: Do not push the Maintenance Room buttons; the blue button started a leak that flooded the room, and drowning cost -10 and ended the game.
Do not re-enter a room where water is rising; about ten returns to the Maintenance Room ended in death at neck-deep water.
Do not run 'return to Living Room' as a long shuttle between two rooms once the route is unknown; try other exits.
Do not wander West/North/South House at the start; about 12 opening moves produced zero score before the window was opened.
Never move in a dark room without light; dark movement in the Cellar caused grue deaths (-10) in earlier runs.
Never 'give' items to the troll; earlier runs ended in death. Wield the sword and attack instead.
Do not descend without both lantern and sword; the trap door bars behind you, so check inventory before 'down'.
Do not revisit the Loud Room or take items like matchbook without a plan; they produced no score after the first +10.
